https://www.inquirer.net/495039/chinese-.summary_zh: 当地渔民要求拆除数百个养鱼网箱。他们称，这些网箱占据了卡巴利蒂安村的卡尔帕伊浅滩当地居民世代赖以维生的水域。卡巴利蒂安渔民表示，中国运营商此前将作业范围限定在苏阿尔海水养殖区，那里设有数千个养鱼网箱。
https://www.inquirer.net/495039/chinese-.body: Local fishermen are demanding the removal of hundreds of fish cages that they said have occupied Calpay Shoal in Barangay Cabalitian, where generations of residents have made their living. They accused workers of the Chinese operators of driving them away from the waters where their families have fished for generations, forcing them to sail to nearby coastal towns. The Cabalitian fishermen said the Chinese operators previously confined their operations to the Sual Mariculture Zone, where thousands of fish cages are located. However, allegedly due to water pollution in the mariculture zone, the operators began transferring their cages to Calpay Shoal in Cabitaogan Bay off Cabalitian Island, said Nicasio Abata, 80, leader of the Small Fisherfolk and Stakeholders of Cabalitian. In an interview with the Inquirer on Saturday (November 7), Abata said 99 fish cage structures had been transferred from the mariculture zone before May 2026, followed by another 33 shortly afterward. “They have no permission from the barangay or the local government to transfer to Calpay Shoal, making their operations illegal,” Abata said. The Sual Municipal Agriculture Office also said it had not issued any permit or authorization for the placement of fish cages in the shoal. “The unmitigated operations of these illegal structures have restricted the traditional fishing grounds of marginalized local fishermen, caused severe ecological degradation, and directly threatened the marine biodiversity of the sea,” the Cabalitian fishermen said in a petition submitted to various government agencies. /mcm

https://www.inquirer.net/495039/chinese-.body_zh: 当地渔民要求拆除数百个养鱼网箱。他们称，这些网箱已经占据Cabalityan_barangay的Calpay浅滩，而当地几代居民一直以此为生。他们指控中国运营商的员工将他们赶离家族世代捕捞的水域，迫使他们前往附近沿海城镇。Cabalityan渔民表示，中国运营商此前将作业范围限定在Sual海水养殖区，那里设有数千个养鱼网箱。然而，80岁的Cabalityan小渔民与利益相关者领袖Nicasio Abata称，据称由于海水养殖区出现水体污染，运营商开始将网箱转移至Cabitaogan湾、Cabalitian岛外海的Calpay浅滩。Abata在周六（11月7日）接受《Inquirer》采访时表示，截至2026年5月，已有99座养鱼网箱设施从海水养殖区转移，随后不久又有33座转移。Abata说：“他们没有得到barangay或地方政府批准将网箱转移至Calpay浅滩，因此其作业属于非法行为。”Sual市农业办公室也表示，未就网箱在该浅滩的设置签发任何许可或授权。Cabalityan渔民在提交给多个政府机构的请愿书中说：“这些非法设施未经减缓措施开展作业，限制了边缘化当地渔民的传统捕捞区域，造成严重生态退化，并直接威胁海洋生物多样性。” /mcm

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: Does Korea need midterm elections?
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: Single presidential tenure with National Assembly election on its own calendar makes midterm assessment more difficult The 2026 U.S. midterm elections delivered a sweeping rebuke to President Donald Trump. Korea has regular elections that can serve as midterm tests, but no guaranteed presidential midterm. To create a guaranteed midterm check, Korea would also need to arrange for a separate election — most plausibly a National Assembly election — to fall at a defined point during the presidential term.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 总统任期单独计算，而国民议会选举则另有时间安排，这让中期评估更加困难。2026年美国中期选举对唐纳德·特朗普总统造成了全面否定。韩国定期举行选举，可充当中期检验，但没有确定在总统任期中期举行的选举。若要建立有保障的中期制衡机制，韩国还须另行安排一场选举——最有可能的是国民议会选举——并将其固定在总统任期内的特定时间举行。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: Single presidential tenure with National Assembly election on its own calendar makes midterm assessment more difficult The 2026 U.S. midterm elections delivered a sweeping rebuke to President Donald Trump. Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress, flipping Senate seats even in Republican strongholds such as Texas, Kansas and South Carolina. The night also brought historic firsts such as the first Muslim and the first openly gay man elected to the U.S. Senate. Voters were passing judgment on Trump’s performance. Many blamed his policies for the high cost of living. The Iran war added to their frustration, through higher fuel prices and doubts about the decision to enter the conflict. Aggressive immigration enforcement was another visible and divisive part of his agenda. No single issue explains the result, but the election gave Americans a chance to voice their discontent and to change who controls Congress. Watching the results from New York, I found myself thinking about how differently Korea delivered its own verdict on a president not long ago. When then-President Yoon Suk Yeol declared martial law in December 2024, citizens rushed to the National Assembly as lawmakers moved swiftly to reject the order. Months of powerful yet peaceful mass protests followed, and Yoon was ultimately removed from office. Of course, the two cases are not equivalent. One was an extraordinary effort to defend constitutional government from an immediate threat. The other was a routine election that shifted the balance of power. But together they show that democratic resilience takes different forms: citizens filling a public square, legislators refusing an unlawful order, voters using the ballot box to constrain a government. Democracies need more than one way for people to hold power to account. Protest is an essential democratic right. When institutions are under threat, public assembly shows that people will not accept the erosion of their rights in silence. But protest cannot carry the whole burden of accountability. The U.S. midterm elections matter because they give citizens a regular, consequential opportunity to judge a government while it is still in office. It is not simply a date on the calendar; it is a constitutional choice about when the public gets its say. Korea has regular elections that can serve as midterm tests, but no guaranteed presidential midterm. Because the presidential term is a single, nonrenewable five years and the National Assembly term is four, general elections fall at a different point in each presidency. In April 2024, about two years into Yoon’s term, voters handed the opposition a landslide, a midterm rebuke in all but name. Under President Lee Jae Myung, the next general election will not come until April 2028, three years into his term. This June’s elections offered voters an early chance to assess Lee’s administration, but they came just one year into his presidency and were shaped mostly by local candidates and concerns, even when national politics loomed large. Korea’s check exists, but its timing is left to the arithmetic of the calendar. Lee has advocated a constitutional amendment to introduce a U.S.-style, four-year presidency with the possibility of a second term, arguing that it would allow a “midterm evaluation” of the administration. A renewable term would give voters a chance to approve or reject a president at the next presidential election. But that election would come at the end of a term, not halfway through it. To create a guaranteed midterm check, Korea would also need to arrange for a separate election — most plausibly a National Assembly election — to fall at a defined point during the presidential term. Together, these changes could strengthen accountability. An incumbent seeking reelection would have to win voters’ approval again, and a scheduled election during the term would give the public an earlier chance to reward or rebuke the government. That might make presidents more attentive to how their policies affect people. It would also give citizens a peaceful, predictable outlet for frustration. There are real risks, too. More frequent national campaigning could deepen polarization, encourage short-term decision-making and leave governments in near-permanent election mode. Local contests might become even more dominated by national battles. And constitutional change is no technical fix. It would require approval by at least two-thirds of the National Assembly and a national referendum, as well as durable public consensus about how the new election schedule should work. Korea does not have to copy the U.S. system to learn from its underlying idea: People should not have to wait until the end of a president’s term to deliver their verdict. Protest, the courts, the National Assembly and elections each serve different purposes. A well-designed midterm could add another democratic check, but no calendar can guarantee accountability on its own. Korea’s recent history makes the point. In 2024, voters delivered a clear midterm verdict on Yoon. Eight months later, he declared martial law against an opposition-controlled Assembly. This week, even Trump, who never conceded his 2020 loss, said he would accept the midterm results. The value of any midterm depends not only on whether it gives citizens a real choice, but on whether political leaders accept the result. Min Seong-jae (smin@pace.edu) is a professor of communication and media studies at Pace University in New York
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 总统单一任期与国民议会选举各自按照自己的时间表进行，使得中期评估更加困难。2026年美国中期选举对唐纳德·特朗普总统作出了全面否定。民主党人赢得国会两院控制权，甚至在得克萨斯州、堪萨斯州和南卡罗来纳州等共和党 stronghold 翻转了参议院席位。当晚还出现了历史性首次，例如首位穆斯林和首位公开出柜同性恋男性当选美国参议员。选民是在评价特朗普的施政表现。许多人把生活成本高企归咎于他的政策。伊朗战争通过推高燃油价格，以及引发人们对决定参战的疑虑，加剧了他们的不满。激进移民执法是他议程中另一项显眼且引发分歧的内容。没有任何单一议题能够解释这一结果，但这次选举给了美国人表达不满并改变国会控制权归属的机会。从纽约看到选举结果时，我不禁想到，韩国不久前以多么不同的方式对一位总统作出了裁决。2024年12月，时任总统尹锡悦宣布戒严时，民众涌向国民议会，议员迅速行动起来否决该命令。随后发生了持续数月、力量强大但保持和平的大规模抗议，尹锡悦最终被免职。当然，这两个案例并不等同。一个是为抵御迫在眉睫的威胁而捍卫宪政的非凡行动，另一个则是改变权力平衡的例行选举。但两者共同表明，民主的韧性有不同表现形式：民众填满公共广场，议员拒绝非法命令，选民利用投票箱约束政府。民主制度需要不止一种让人民追究权力责任的方式。抗议是一项基本的民主权利。当制度受到威胁时，公众集会表明人民不会默默接受权利遭到侵蚀。但不能把全部问责重担都压在抗议上。美国中期选举之所以重要，是因为它们让公民在政府仍在任时获得定期且具有实质影响的机会来评判政府。它不只是日历上的一个日期，而是一项关于公众何时能够发言的宪政选择。韩国定期举行选举，可以充当期中检验，却没有确定的总统任期中期选举。由于总统任期是单一且不可连任的5年，而国民议会任期为4年，大选会在每届总统任期的不同时间举行。2024年4月，也就是尹锡悦任期约两年时，选民以压倒性优势把胜利交给反对派，这是一场除了名义之外各方面都算得上期中否定的选举。在李在明总统领导下，下一次大选要到2028年4月才会举行，届时他的任期已过去三年。今年6月的选举让选民得以提前评估李在明政府，但距离他就任仅一年，而且主要由地方候选人和地方议题塑造，即便国家政治占据重要位置。韩国的制衡机制确实存在，但其时机取决于日历上的算术。李在明一直主张修宪，引入美国式4年总统制，并允许连任一个任期，认为这将使政府能够接受“中期评估”。可连任的任期会让选民有机会在下一次总统选举中批准或否决总统。但那次选举将在任期结束时举行，而不是在任期中途举行。若要建立确定的期中制衡，韩国还需要另行安排一次选举——最有可能的是国民议会选举——在总统任期内的某个明确时间举行。这些变化结合起来可以加强问责。寻求连任的在任总统必须再次赢得选民的认可，而任期中定期举行的选举会让公众更早获得奖励或批评政府的机会。这可能促使总统更加关注政策对民众的影响，也会为公民提供一个和平且可预期的发泄不满渠道。这里也存在现实风险。更频繁的全国竞选活动可能加剧两极分化、助长短期决策，并使政府几乎永久处于选举状态。地方选举也可能变得更加受全国政治斗争支配。宪法改革同样不是技术性修补方案。它需要国民议会至少三分之二多数通过，并经全国公投批准，同时还需要公众就新的选举时间安排形成持久共识。韩国不必照搬美国制度，也能从其内在理念中汲取教训：人民不应非得等到总统任期结束才有机会作出裁决。抗议、法院、国民议会和选举各自发挥不同作用。设计良好的期中选举可以增加一项民主制衡，但仅靠任何日历安排都无法保证问责。韩国近期的历史恰好说明了这一点。2024年，选民对尹锡悦作出了明确的期中裁决。8个月后，他宣布在一个由反对派掌控的国民议会面前实施戒严。本周，就连从未承认自己2020年败选的特朗普也表示将接受中期选举结果。任何期中选举的价值，不仅取决于它是否给公民提供真正的选择，也取决于政治领导人是否接受结果。Min Seong-jae（smin@pace.edu）是纽约佩斯大学传播与媒体研究教授。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: SK hynix Inc.的母公司周一表示，韩国芯片制造商SK hynix Inc.正准备扩大其美国员工队伍，此举似乎是为了加强与包括Nvidia Corp.在内的美国主要客户的联系。SK hynix计划在12月前后增聘高级管理人员，并对其美国业务进行重组。SK hynix此前新设了一个负责美国业务的高管职位，并任命负责开发工作的总裁Ahn Hyun担任该职。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Korean chipmaker SK hynix Inc. is preparing to expand its U.S. workforce, its parent company said Monday, in what appears to be a move to strengthen ties with major U.S. clients, including Nvidia Corp. SK hynix plans to make additional executive appointments and reorganize its U.S. operations around Dec. 3, according to SK Group. The planned changes follow a recent executive reshuffle at SK Group, a Korean conglomerate with businesses spanning semiconductors, construction and other sectors. SK hynix had created a new executive-level post overseeing its U.S. operations and appointed Ahn Hyun, its president in charge of development, to the position. Ahn has led the development of artificial intelligence (AI) memory products, including high bandwidth memory (HBM) at SK hynix. The appointment marks a shift in the company's approach to managing its U.S. operations, which have traditionally been headed by executives with sales and marketing backgrounds. Industry sources said the move reflects changes in how HBM contracts are secured as memory chipmakers increasingly work with customers from the early stages of product development to tailor chips to their AI infrastructure. "Companies can no longer maintain their competitiveness without working closely with customers, starting from the R&D stage," an industry official said, requesting anonymity

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Leaders of the main opposition People Power Party (PPP) gathered outside Cheong Wa Dae on Monday to protest the recent passage of a bill calling for a special counsel investigation into alleged fabricated indictments targeting President Lee Jae Myung and others. The PPP leadership held a Supreme Council meeting outside the presidential office, after the ruling Democratic Party of Korea railroaded the bill through a plenary session of the National Assembly on Friday. The legislation calls for appointing an independent counsel to investigate suspicions the prosecution under former President Yoon Suk Yeol fabricated evidence or induced false testimonies to build cases against then opposition leader Lee and others. The PPP has denounced the effort as a pretext to cancel all of Lee's indictments, as his trials have been suspended under an article of the Constitution that exempts a sitting president from criminal prosecution except in cases of insurrection or treason. Lee faces charges of involvement in corrupt development schemes, illegal remittances to North Korea, and the misuse of a government charge card, stemming from his time as mayor of Seongnam or governor of Gyeonggi Province. "Lee Jae Myung's 'prison break bill' has passed the National Assembly and arrived at Cheong Wa Dae," PPP leader Jang Dong-hyeok said during the meeting, suggesting it would be approved at Tuesday's Cabinet meeting. "The key to freeing prisoner Lee Jae Myung has been placed in prisoner Lee Jae Myung's hands." Jang warned of judgment from the people should the bill be approved, including through possible impeachment. The PPP's resistance to the bill has taken various forms, with a rally held Friday outside the National Assembly and a massive outdoor rally staged near Gyeongbok Palace in central Seoul on Saturday. A relay of one-person protests outside Cheong Wa Dae has been scheduled for Monday. Rep. Jeong Jeom-sig, the party's floor leader, started it off as the first participant. On Tuesday, the party has vowed to hold a general meeting of lawmakers outside the presidential office

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Kim Jin-a, second vice minister of foreign affairs, delivered a lecture on the changing international order and the challenges facing Korean diplomacy at the Seoul campus of Hankuk University of Foreign Studies (HUFS) on Nov. 4. The university said the lecture was part of the 2026 HUFS Special Lecture program, which provides students, alums and young people in the local community with opportunities to gain insights into the humanities and develop skills for their future careers. The program combines the university’s traditional strengths in diplomacy, international trade and the humanities with emerging issues such as artificial intelligence (AI) and big data. In her lecture, titled “Changes in the International Order and Korea’s Diplomatic Choices,” Kim discussed the role and importance of diplomacy in the evolving international environment. She also introduced various programs and initiatives pursued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and shared information to help students broaden their interest in international affairs and explore career opportunities in diplomacy. Kim earned a doctorate in international relations from the Fletcher School of Law and Diplomacy at Tufts University in the United States. She previously served as a professor and dean of the Division of Language and Diplomacy at Hankuk University of Foreign Studies. Her previous positions include policy adviser to the Ministry of National Defense, the Joint Chiefs of Staff and the Air Force, and director of the North Korean Military Research Division at the Korea Institute for Defense Analyses. She was also a member of the U.N. Advisory Board on Disarmament Matters. The lecture carried added significance as Kim, who once taught at HUFS, returned to the university to address students in her capacity as a senior diplomat. The university said it will continue expanding the special lecture program, providing opportunities for students to interact with experts from various fields and connecting academic knowledge with practical, real-world experience
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 第二副外长在HUFS讲座上讨论外交的作用
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国外交部第二次官金真娥于11月4日在韩国外贸大学（HUFS）首尔校区就国际秩序的变革以及韩国外交面临的挑战发表演讲。该校表示，此次演讲是“2026年HUFS特别讲座”系列活动的一部分。该项目为学生、校友及当地社区青年提供机会，使其能够从人文学科中获得启迪，并培养未来职业生涯所需的技能。项目将学校在外交、国际贸易和人文学科方面的传统优势与人工智能（AI）、大数据等新兴议题相结合。在题为《国际秩序的变化与韩国的外交选择》的演讲中，金真娥探讨了外交在不断变化的国际环境中的作用和重要性。她还介绍了外交部推进的各项项目和倡议，并分享相关信息，帮助学生拓展对国际事务的兴趣，探索外交领域的职业机会。金真娥毕业于美国塔夫茨大学弗莱彻法律与外交学院，获国际关系博士学位。她此前曾任韩国外贸大学语言与外交学部教授兼院长。她曾担任国防部、联合参谋部和空军的政策顾问，以及韩国国防研究院朝鲜军事研究室主任。她还曾担任联合国裁军事务咨询委员会成员。此次演讲更具意义：金真娥曾任教于HUFS，如今以高级外交官身份重返母校，与学生面对面交流。该校表示，将继续拓展特别讲座项目，为学生提供与各领域专家交流互动的机会，并将学术知识与现实实践经验相衔接

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: CJ Olive Young, Korea’s largest health and beauty store chain, will open five more stores in California by the first half of 2027, bringing its U.S. total to seven, the company said Monday. The retailer opened its first U.S. store in Pasadena in May and a second at Westfield Century City in Los Angeles in June. Four of the new stores will be in the greater Los Angeles area: Spectrum Center, a lifestyle shopping center in Irvine; Del Amo Fashion Center in the South Bay area; Bloom on 3rd, a shopping complex near the Farmers Market in central Los Angeles; and Brea Mall in Orange County. The fifth will open at Fashion Valley in San Diego, its first outside the Los Angeles area. Opening dates for each store have not been set. Three of the sites — Del Amo Fashion Center, Brea Mall and Fashion Valley — are operated by Simon Property Group, a major U.S. mall owner. The company said the expansion will help small and independent Korean cosmetics brands, collectively known as K-beauty, reach American consumers without their own distribution networks. Olive Young said its stores also introduce shoppers to product types common in Korea, such as sunscreen sticks, cushion compacts that dispense sunscreen through a sponge, and toner pads, which are cotton pads presoaked in skin toner. Its in-store Skin Scan service, which analyzes a customer’s skin condition and recommends products, had been used by about 27,000 customers as of late October, roughly five months after the first store opened. “Olive Young’s U.S. stores serve as a bridge that helps emerging brands settle into the mainstream market,” an Olive Young official said. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body: Korea’s national tourism agency has secured major promotional agreements with leading Southeast Asian online travel platforms, airlines and financial institutions as part of an aggressive push to convert growing regional interest in Korean culture into actual travel bookings. The sales drive comes as tourism from the region surges. Visitor arrivals from Indonesia reached 330,629 through September, a 23.4 percent increase compared to the same period last year. Meanwhile, the Philippines remains Korea’s top source of tourists in Southeast Asia, with arrivals rising 15.6 percent year-over-year following a record 615,141 visitors last year. To capitalize on the momentum, the agency signed a memorandum of understanding on Wednesday with Traveloka, Southeast Asia’s dominant online travel agency. Leveraging Traveloka’s commercial network across five countries, including Singapore and Malaysia, the two organizations aim to jointly attract 300,000 tourists to Korea over the next two years. The delegation signed an agreement on Friday with Cebu Pacific Air, the Philippines’ largest low-cost carrier, to run joint promotional campaigns tied to a major K-pop concert scheduled in the Philippines next March. The initiative aims to drive independent travel and boost passenger traffic to Korea’s regional airports beyond Seoul. The agency also partnered with major financial institutions to streamline travel bookings and financial transactions. A pact with Bank Central Asia, Indonesia’s largest private lender, will offer targeted card promotions and payment perks for travel to Korea. In Manila, a partnership with BDO Unibank will target family travel, linking card benefits with simplified Korean visa procedures. "This sales initiative successfully turned regional interest in Korea into real travel demand through close cooperation with local market leaders," Park said. "We will continue expanding multi-faceted partnerships with global corporations to grow inbound visitor numbers while driving qualitative growth and regional tourism." https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: 3-week crackdown inspects heating, contract terms and safety for migrant workers across 160 coastal sites Korea has launched a comprehensive three-week inspection campaign targeting coastal fishing households that employ foreign seasonal workers, seeking to root out labor abuses and improve living standards in the country’s aging maritime sector. The joint crackdown, led by the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, began Monday and will cover roughly 160 fishing households across the nation through Nov. 27. The initiative arrives amid growing scrutiny over the treatment of foreign laborers brought in to relieve severe workforce shortages in rural coastal communities. Officials said joint inspection teams — comprising government personnel, local authorities and civil rights groups — will directly visit five municipal regions with large seasonal worker allocations or lingering allegations of human rights violations. Local governments will independently audit an additional 22 municipalities. Inspectors are focusing on compliance with standard labor contracts, the provision of adequate heating and housing ahead of the winter season, mandatory insurance coverage, and unpaid wages. Crucially, officials are conducting face-to-face interviews with workers to detect systemic abuses, such as the illegal confiscation of passports and bankbooks, or restrictions on freedom of movement and communication. Substandard conditions will carry direct penalties. Farms failing to rectify violations face demerit points and potential bans on receiving foreign seasonal workers in future quota allocations. The winter monitoring comes against the backdrop of persistent, high-profile tragedies and abuses involving foreign agricultural and maritime workers. Public outcry intensified following the December 2020 death of a Cambodian worker found dead inside an unheated, makeshift greenhouse dormitory in Pocheon during a minus-17-degree Celsius cold snap — a landmark case that led the Supreme Court to hold the government liable for failing to conduct mandatory workplace safety inspections. Similar abuses resurfaced in late 2024 when a Cambodian worker in Yongin shared viral footage of her collapsed, water-logged greenhouse shelter following heavy snowfall, highlighting how many migrant laborers remain exposed to hazardous winter living conditions, unheated structures and sudden evictions. The inspections come as Korea relies increasingly on foreign labor to sustain its essential industries amid rapid demographic aging and a shrinking domestic rural workforce. The foreign seasonal worker program has expanded rapidly in recent years, but rapid growth has raised concerns over regulatory oversight and worker welfare in isolated coastal environments. “The safety and human rights of foreign seasonal workers are fundamental principles that must be protected,” said Cha Yong-ho, head of the justice ministry’s Korea Immigration Service. Choi Hyun-ho, head of the Fisheries Policy Bureau at the oceans ministry, emphasized that tangible improvements to working and living environments are critical to ensuring foreign laborers can work safely in coastal regions. By pairing strict regulatory enforcement with on-the-ground worker interviews, authorities aim to secure both basic human rights and long-term sustainability for Korea’s marine economy. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国检查沿海农场，以保护外来渔业工人
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国开展为期三周的检查行动，在160个沿海场所审查供暖、合同条款和移民工人安全情况。韩国启动了一项全面为期三周的检查行动，重点针对雇用外国季节工的沿海捕鱼家庭，旨在根除劳动侵害并改善该国老龄化海洋产业从业者的生活水平。由司法部和海洋水产部共同牵头开展的联合检查于周一开始，将持续至11月27日，覆盖全国约160个捕鱼家庭。在越来越多外来劳动者被引入农村沿海社区，以缓解严重劳动力短缺之际，此举受到广泛关注。官员表示，由政府人员、地方政府和公民权利团体组成的联合检查队将实地走访5个市辖区，这些地区分配了较多季节工，或仍存在侵犯人权的指控。地方政府还将独立审查另外22个市镇。检查人员重点审查是否符合标准劳动合同、是否在冬季来临前提供充足供暖和住房、是否依法投保以及是否存在拖欠工资。尤为重要的是，官员正与工人面对面访谈，以发现系统性侵害，例如非法没收护照和银行卡，或限制行动及通信自由。条件不达标的经营场所将受到直接处罚。未纠正违规行为的农场将被记入不良记录，并可能在今后的外国季节工配额分配中被禁止接收外国季节工。此次冬季监督行动的背景，是涉及外国农业和海事工人的严重、高关注度悲剧与侵害持续发生。2020年12月，在零下17摄氏度的寒潮中，一名柬埔寨工人被发现死在浦川一个没有供暖的临时温室宿舍内，引发公众强烈抗议。这一标志性案件促使最高法院裁定政府因未履行强制性工作场所安全检查义务而承担责任。类似侵害在2024年末再次浮现。一名在龙仁工作的柬埔寨工人分享了一段广泛传播的视频，显示她的温室住所在大雪后坍塌并严重积水，凸显出许多移民工人仍暴露在危险的冬季居住条件、无供暖建筑和突然驱逐之下。随着人口迅速老龄化以及国内农村劳动力萎缩，韩国日益依赖外国劳动力维持其关键产业。外国季节工计划近年来迅速扩张，但快速增长也引发了对偏远沿海环境监管和工人福祉的担忧。司法部韩国出入境管理局局长车永浩表示：“外国季节工的安全与人权是必须得到保护的基本原则。”海洋水产部渔业政策局局长崔贤浩强调，改善工作和生活环境的具体举措对于确保外国劳动者能够在沿海地区安全工作是至关重要的。通过将严格的监管执法与一线工人访谈相结合，当局旨在保障基本人权，并推动韩国海洋经济实现长期可持续发展。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: LG AI Research, the artificial intelligence (AI) research arm of LG Group, opened the application programming interface (API) for its upgraded EXAONE 2.5 foundation model free of charge, reporting a performance boost of over 70 percent in just eight weeks. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: LG集团旗下人工智能研究机构LG AI Research免费开放升级版EXAONE 2.5基础模型的应用程序编程接口（API），并称该模型在短短八周内性能提升超过70%。从同一天起，开发人员、初创企业、公司和研究机构均可通过该公司的平台docs.exaone.ai获取API密钥，免费在自身服务和研究中使用该模型。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: LG AI Research, the artificial intelligence (AI) research arm of LG Group, opened the application programming interface (API) for its upgraded EXAONE 2.5 foundation model free of charge, reporting a performance boost of over 70 percent in just eight weeks. The company announced the move at NVIDIA AI Day Seoul 2026, held at Coex in southern Seoul on Monday. Starting the same day, developers, startups, companies and research institutes can use the model in their services and research at no cost by obtaining an API key through the company’s platform, docs.exaone.ai. K-EXAONE 2.5 is a technology verification model built by applying additional training to K-EXAONE 2.0, the second model LG AI Research developed under the government’s sovereign AI foundation model project, which aims to build homegrown AI models that reduce Korea’s reliance on foreign systems. According to the company’s own tests on open datasets, K-EXAONE 2.5 performed on par with leading Chinese open-weight models DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM 5.3 (max) in agentic AI, in which AI plans tasks and uses tools on its own to complete real work. It scored 74.6 on AutomationBench, which measures task automation using software-as-a-service tools, compared with 74.9 for DeepSeek and 71.6 for GLM. On Claw-Eval, BrowseComp and SWE-Bench Pro, which test workplace problem-solving, web browsing and software development, it scored 77.3, 78.0 and 59.2, respectively. “Internal analysis showed that overall performance across 24 benchmarks improved by more than 70 percent compared with the model released in July,” said Kim Yi-reun, head of the EXAONE Lab. The company is also reviewing the use of NVIDIA’s Dynamo technology to improve inference efficiency. LG AI Research plans to apply the training techniques validated through K-EXAONE 2.5 to its third-round model. “We will focus on completing an EXAONE model with frontier-level performance by January next year,” said Lim Woo-hyung, co-head of LG AI Research. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Nvidia, SK Telecom and domestic artificial intelligence (AI) chip startup Rebellions agreed Monday to combine their respective strengths to establish a heterogeneous computing system, Seoul's science ministry said. Under the trilateral memorandum of understanding (MOU), the companies will cooperate in the establishment of a heterogeneous AI computing system connecting Nvidia's graphic processing units (GPUs) with neural processing units (NPUs) designed by Rebellions that will be used in the building of SK Telecom AI data centers. The tie-up will be based on the U.S. chipmaker's NVLink Fusion program, the ministry added. The NVLink Fusion program allows hyperscalers and custom chip designers to integrate their own AI processors directly into Nvidia's rack-scale infrastructure. The MOU was signed on the margins of AI Day Seoul, a tech event hosted by Nvidia that kicked off its two-day run in southern Seoul. The agreement to connect locally produced NPUs to Nvidia's architecture will help expand the scope of application for domestic advanced semiconductors. It will also provide an opportunity for local companies to verify their technologies in the global market, the science ministry explained. The science ministry vowed to support local NPU developers to ensure such collaboration could extend beyond Rebellions to other local NPU developers, and eventually help develop Korea's advanced-chip ecosystem
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 英伟达、SKT和Rebellions将联合建立人工智能异构计算系统
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 韩国首尔科学部门周一表示，Nvidia、SK Telecom以及韩国本土人工智能芯片初创企业Rebellions同意整合各自优势，建立异构计算系统。根据三方谅解备忘录（MOU），这些公司将合作建立异构人工智能计算系统，将Nvidia的图形处理器（GPU）与Rebellions设计的神经处理单元（NPU）连接起来，并将其用于建设SK Telecom的人工智能数据中心。科学部门补充称，此次合作将以这家美国芯片制造商的NVLink Fusion计划为基础。NVLink Fusion计划允许超大规模云计算企业和定制芯片设计商将自有人工智能处理器直接接入Nvidia的机架级基础设施。谅解备忘录在由Nvidia主办、于首尔南部启动为期两天活动的科技大会AI Day Seoul期间签署。科学部门解释称，将本土生产的NPU接入Nvidia架构的协议，将有助于扩大韩国先进半导体的应用范围，也将为本土企业提供验证其技术并进入全球市场的机会。科学部门承诺支持本土NPU开发商，确保此类合作能够从Rebellions扩展至其他本土NPU开发商，并最终推动韩国先进芯片生态系统的发展

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Hyundai Card Vice Chairman Ted Chung has been named an honorary trustee of the Museum of Modern Art (MoMA) in New York, the card issuer said Monday. The honorary title recognizes individuals who have made significant contributions to the museum through their expertise and international influence. In the role, trustees offer strategic counsel on MoMA’s major decisions, long-term vision and institutional priorities. Since 2006, the partnership between Hyundai Card and MoMA has taken many forms, from exhibition sponsorships to curatorial exchanges and research initiatives, which have helped bring Korean art into view for the museum’s 2.8 million annual visitors. The collaboration has brought solo presentations by leading contemporary Korean artists to the New York museum, including Haegue Yang and Kim Sung-hwan, whose exhibitions were part of a programming initiative known as the Hyundai Card Performance Series. Last year, genre-defying media artist Ayoung Kim made her U.S. solo debut with her celebrated “Delivery Dancer” series at MoMA PS1, a space dedicated to championing experimental practices and boundary-pushing ideas. Beyond its exhibition program, the relationship has also opened up new avenues for research. A curatorial exchange initiative launched in 2024 has brought MoMA curators into contact with artists and creative practitioners across disciplines, expanding the museum’s engagement with Korea’s contemporary art scene and informing new acquisitions. The next milestone is a Korean art volume in MoMA’s “Primary Documents” series, scheduled for publication in 2027. The series makes key writings and source materials on modern and contemporary art from outside the United States accessible to English-speaking audiences through meticulously edited translations. “Over the past 20 years, Vice Chairman Chung has played an unprecedented role in expanding MoMA’s presence in Korea, while opening new avenues for our curators and audiences to deepen their understanding of and engagement with Korean art and artists,” MoMA Director Christophe Cherix said. “Hyundai Card does not support art. Rather, art supports Hyundai Card,” Chung said, expressing his conviction that art is a force that can inform how businesses think and innovate
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 现代艺术博物馆任命现代卡副董事长郑德永为荣誉受托人
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 信用卡公司Monday表示，现代艺术博物馆（MoMA）已任命现代汽车信用卡副董事长郑Ted为纽约现代艺术博物馆名誉受托人。名誉头衔旨在表彰那些凭借专业知识和国际影响力为博物馆作出重要贡献的人士。担任该职务的受托人将就MoMA的重大决策、长期愿景和机构优先事项提供战略咨询。自2006年以来，现代汽车信用卡与MoMA的合作以多种形式展开，从展览赞助、策展交流到研究项目，帮助韩国艺术进入该馆每年280万名参观者的视野。该合作促成了韩国顶尖当代艺术家的个展在纽约这家博物馆举办，包括Haegue Yang和Kim Sung-hwan；他们的展览属于名为“现代汽车信用卡演出系列”的项目。去年，打破既定艺术门类的媒体艺术家Ayoung Kim凭借备受赞誉的“Delivery Dancer”系列在MoMA PS1首次举办美国个人展览。MoMA PS1是一个致力于倡导实验性实践和突破边界的想法的空间。除了展览项目，双方关系还开辟了新的研究途径。2024年启动的策展交流项目让MoMA策展人得以接触不同领域的艺术家和创意实践者，扩大了博物馆与韩国当代艺术界的联系，并为新的藏品收购提供参考。下一个里程碑是MoMA“Primary Documents”系列中的一卷韩国艺术著作，计划于2027年出版。该系列通过严谨编辑的译本，让英语读者能够接触美国以外现代与当代艺术领域的重要论述和原始资料。MoMA馆长Christophe Cherix表示：“过去20年来，郑副董事长在扩大MoMA于韩国的影响力方面发挥了前所未有的作用，同时为我们的策展人和观众开辟了新的途径，以加深他们對韩国艺术和韩国艺术家的了解与参与。”郑表示：“现代汽车信用卡并不支持艺术。相反，艺术支持现代汽车信用卡。”他坚定地认为，艺术是一股能够启发企业思考与创新的力量

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: LG Uplus is joining forces with three leading Korean universities to develop artificial intelligence (AI) that can understand not only what people say but also their tone, emotions and conversational context, in a push to make interactions between humans and machines more natural. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: LG Uplus将与韩国三所顶尖大学携手研发人工智能（AI），使其不仅能理解人们说了什么，还能辨别他们的语气、情绪和对话语境，从而让人与机器之间的互动更加自然。这家电信企业周一宣布，已与首尔大学（SNU）、韩国科学技术院（KAIST）和延世大学共同成立K-Voice人工智能联盟。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: LG Uplus is joining forces with three leading Korean universities to develop artificial intelligence (AI) that can understand not only what people say but also their tone, emotions and conversational context, in a push to make interactions between humans and machines more natural. The telecommunications company said Monday it had launched the K-Voice AI Alliance with Seoul National University (SNU), the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) and Yonsei University. The partnership aims to combine LG Uplus' experience in voice AI services with the universities' research capabilities to develop technology specifically tailored to Korean speakers. The project will focus on voice-to-voice (V2V) technology, which allows AI to understand spoken language directly and respond with speech, without first converting conversations into text. Traditional voice AI systems process speech recognition, response generation and voice output in separate stages, a process that can cause delays and produce unnatural-sounding responses. The alliance plans to establish performance evaluation standards for Korean-language voice AI and jointly develop a platform called the K-Voice Engine for use in various services. SNU will develop technology that enables AI to adjust its speaking style and voice to different situations while responding naturally to users. KAIST will research how AI can identify whom to address in group conversations and retain context during extended exchanges. Yonsei University will examine how effectively customers understand explanations and complete consultations when voice AI is used in customer service. LG Uplus plans to gradually incorporate the research findings into its voice AI services. Lee Sang-yeob, chief technology officer of LG Uplus, said voice was essential to making AI accessible and natural for everyone. “Voice is an important means of enabling everyone to use AI easily and naturally,” Lee said. “Through this academic-industry partnership, we will secure K-Voice AI technology tailored to Korean people and the Korean language, provide customers with new voice AI experiences and strengthen our technological competitiveness so that fewer people, including older adults, are left behind in the AI era,” he said. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: LG Uplus携手首尔大学、延世大学和韩国科学技术院开发面向韩语的语音人工智能
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: LG Uplus正与韩国三所顶尖大学携手开发人工智能（AI），使其不仅能理解人们说了什么，还能理解人们的语气、情绪和对话背景，以推动人机互动更加自然。这家电信公司周一表示，已与首尔大学（SNU）、韩国科学技术院（KAIST）和延世大学共同发起“K-Voice AI联盟”。该合作旨在结合LG Uplus在语音AI服务方面的经验与各大学的研究能力，开发专门针对韩国使用者的技术。该项目将重点研发语音到语音（V2V）技术，使AI无需先将对话转换为文字，就能直接理解口语并以语音回应。传统语音AI系统将语音识别、回应生成和语音输出分阶段处理，这一流程可能造成延迟，并使回应听起来不自然。该联盟计划为韩语语音AI建立性能评估标准，并联合开发名为“K-Voice Engine”的平台，用于各类服务。首尔大学将开发相关技术，使AI在回应用户时能够根据不同情境调整说话方式和音色，并作出自然回应。韩国科学技术院将研究AI如何在多人对话中判断应向谁发言，以及在长时间交流中保留上下文。延世大学将研究在客服领域使用语音AI时，客户理解说明和完成咨询的效果。LG Uplus计划逐步将这些研究成果纳入其语音AI服务。LG Uplus首席技术官李相烨表示，语音是让AI对每个人而言都触手可及且自然易用的关键。李相烨说：“语音是让每个人都能轻松、自然地使用AI的重要方式。通过这项产学合作，我们将获得针对韩国人和韩语打造的K-Voice AI技术，为客户提供全新的语音AI体验，并增强我们的技术竞争力，让包括老年人在内的更少有人在AI时代掉队。”这篇报道在生成式AI协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 韩国公平交易委员会周一表示，已决定要求相关企业纠正不公平行为，并对运营Baemin的Woowa Brothers处以331.1亿韩元的临时罚款，对运营Coupang Eats的Coupang处以300.8亿韩元的临时罚款。公平交易委员会称，Coupang于2019年进入外卖应用市场，并从2023年7月至2026年1月对餐厅实施最惠国待遇要求。Woowa Brothers和Coupang Eats的官员对公平交易委员会此次制裁表示遗憾。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: The Fair Trade Commission (FTC) said Monday it has decided to order the companies to rectify the unfair practices and impose provisional fines of 331.1 billion won on Woowa Brothers, the operator of Baemin, and 300.8 billion won on Coupang, which operates Coupang Eats. The two platforms account for more than 90 percent of the nation’s food delivery market share. According to the regulator's investigation, both companies abused their market power to impose so-called most-favored-nation (MFN) requirements on restaurants, restricting their ability to offer different prices, discounts and other terms through competing delivery platforms. The FTC said the practices made it difficult for restaurants to establish more favorable conditions on rival platforms and weakened competition in the delivery market. An MFN requirement refers to a demand that a business partner provide terms that are no less favorable than those offered to competitors. Coupang, which entered the delivery app market in 2019, imposed MFN requirements on restaurants from July 2023 to January 2026, according to the FTC. Restaurants that failed to meet the requirements could lose the WOW store status, potentially resulting in a significant sales decline, according to the FTC investigation. The regulator said Coupang’s MFN requirements became increasingly widespread, with the proportion of WOW stores meeting the conditions rising from about 13 percent in July 2023 to 94 percent in October 2025. Baemin adopted a similar strategy as competition with Coupang intensified. The platform required restaurants using its own-delivery service to meet MFN conditions covering menu prices, minimum order amounts and discounts from May 2024 to October 2025. The proportion of Baemin Club stores meeting the conditions increased from about 63 percent in May 2024 to around 80 percent in January 2025, according to the FTC. The regulator said restaurants largely accepted the demands because exclusion from the programs could lead to substantial sales losses. The FTC also sanctioned Baemin for allegedly forcing restaurants to switch from its marketplace delivery service, where restaurants arrange delivery themselves, to Baemin’s own-delivery service. It also imposed a penalty over what it called misleading advertising concerning estimated delivery times. Of Baemin’s 331.1 billion won fine, 160.2 billion won was related to its MFN requirements, 155.4 billion won to the forced switch to its own-delivery service and 15.4 billion won to misleading delivery-time advertising. “The measures were necessary to correct unfair practices in the delivery app market and prevent dominant platforms from using their market power to restrict the business activities of restaurants and competing platforms,” an FTC official said. Officials from Woowa Brothers and Coupang Eats expressed regret over the latest sanction by the FTC. “We have consistently explained that there was no illegality involved in this matter," an official from Woowa Brothers said. "We regret that our explanation was not sufficiently accepted.” Coupang Eats also said the company plans to carefully review the final written decision and fully present its position through the appropriate legal procedures
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: Woowa Brothers和Coupang因滥用配送市场支配地位面临4.65亿美元罚款
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 韩国公平交易委员会周一表示，已决定责令相关企业纠正不公平行为，并对外卖平台Woowa Brothers（Baemin运营商）处以331.1亿韩元临时罚款，对运营Coupang Eats的Coupang处以300.8亿韩元罚款。这两大平台占韩国食品配送市场份额的90%以上。据该监管机构调查，两家公司滥用市场支配地位，对餐厅实施所谓“最惠国（MFN）”要求，限制餐厅通过竞争性配送平台提供不同价格、折扣及其他服务条件的能力。公平交易委员会表示，这些做法使餐厅难以在竞争平台上获得更有利的条件，并削弱了配送市场竞争。所谓最惠国要求，是指要求商业伙伴提供的条件不得逊于向竞争者提供的条件。公平交易委员会称，Coupang于2019年进入配送应用市场，并从2023年7月至2026年1月对餐厅实施最惠国要求。调查称，未能满足相关要求的餐厅可能失去WOW门店资格，从而导致销售额大幅下降。监管机构表示，Coupang的最惠国要求日益普遍，符合相关条件的WOW门店占比从2023年7月的约13%升至2025年10月的94%。随着与Coupang的竞争加剧，Baemin采取了类似策略。自2024年5月至2025年10月，该平台要求使用其自营配送服务的餐厅满足最惠国条件，条件涵盖菜单价格、最低订单金额和折扣。公平交易委员会称，符合相关条件的Baemin Club门店占比从2024年5月的约63%升至2025年1月的约80%。监管机构表示，餐厅之所以在很大程度上接受了这些要求，是因为被排除在相关项目之外可能导致销售额大幅减少。公平交易委员会还因涉嫌迫使餐厅从其平台配送服务转用Baemin自营配送服务而对Baemin实施制裁。该委员会还就其所称的预计配送时间误导性广告对Baemin处以罚款。在Baemin被处以的331.1亿韩元罚款中，160.2亿韩元与其最惠国要求有关，155.4亿韩元与强迫餐厅转用自营配送服务有关，15.4亿韩元与配送时间误导性广告有关。公平交易委员会一名官员表示：“采取这些措施是为了纠正配送应用市场中的不公平行为，并防止占主导地位的平台利用其市场支配地位限制餐厅和竞争平台的经营活动。”Woowa Brothers和Coupang Eats的官员对公平交易委员会此次制裁表示遗憾。Woowa Brothers一名官员称：“我们一直说明此事不存在违法行为。我们对未能充分获得认可感到遗憾。”Coupang Eats也表示，公司计划认真审查最终书面决定，并通过适当的法律程序充分陈述自身立场

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.title: How to celebrate Pepero Day, Korea's sweetest tradition
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.summary: Welcome to Pepero Day, one of Korea’s most vibrant and fun informal holidays. Today, the tradition has evolved into a nationwide celebration of friendship, romance and affection, where exchanging Pepero sticks is the ultimate way to show someone you care. Participating in Korea’s most popular November tradition does not require breaking the bank.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.summary_zh: 欢迎来到Pepero节，这是韩国最充满活力、最有趣的非正式节日之一。如今，这一传统已发展成为举国庆祝友谊、浪漫和感情的节日，互赠Pepero饼干棒是向心爱之人表达关怀的终极方式。参与韩国这项最受欢迎的11月传统活动无需花费太多。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body: If you happen to be in Korea on Nov. 11, you might notice store shelves overflowing with boxes of thin, chocolate-coated biscuit sticks. Welcome to Pepero Day, one of Korea’s most vibrant and fun informal holidays. First launched by Lotte Wellfood in 1983, Pepero has grown from a simple brand name into a household term representing all long, thin biscuit sticks here. Today, the tradition has evolved into a nationwide celebration of friendship, romance and affection, where exchanging Pepero sticks is the ultimate way to show someone you care. Whether you are looking for a quick wallet-friendly treat or an over-the-top artisan gift, here is your complete guide to navigating Pepero Day. Participating in Korea’s most popular November tradition does not require breaking the bank. Ahead of Nov. 11, the country’s leading convenience store chains — CU, GS25, 7-Eleven and Emart24 — decorate their store fronts with giant displays of Pepero. For 1,500 won to 2,000 won (about $1.1 to $1.5) per box, consumers can sample a wide lineup ranging from nostalgic staples to seasonal releases. The lineup begins with the foundational original chocolate stick in its iconic red box, which pairs a slender, crisp biscuit with a simple milk chocolate coating. For those who prefer a richer texture, the green-boxed almond variety, which comes covered in chocolate and crushed roasted nuts, remains a crowd favorite. Beyond the brightly lit aisles of neighborhood convenience stores overflowing with mass-produced red boxes, a quieter, more sophisticated tradition takes shape in Seoul’s trendy boutique districts every November. Artisan chocolatiers and independent bakeries across neighborhoods like Yeonnam-dong, Hannam-dong and Gangnam transform the humble, mass-market biscuit stick into an elevated culinary canvas. Rather than using factory-extruded biscuit bases, pastry chefs hand-roll butter-rich sablé dough, crisp langue de chat or delicate pretzel batons. These bases are baked to precise crunchiness before being covered in single-origin dark chocolate, roasted matcha couverture or creamy white chocolate. Soso Baking in Seongsu-dong, Seongdong District, is a trendy dessert studio viral on social media for its visual appeal, featuring unique creations like crispy-yet-moist Pepero-style financier pastries. You can celebrate Pepero Day like a local by grabbing a couple of classic boxes from your neighborhood corner store on your morning walk to hand out to coworkers, classmates or your morning barista. Spreading the love is as simple as giving out those treats with a cheerful "Happy Pepero Day!" along the way
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.title_zh: 如何庆祝韩国最甜蜜的传统——Pepero日
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body_zh: 如果你11月11日恰好在韩国，可能会注意到商店货架上堆满了盒装的细长巧克力涂层饼干棒。欢迎来到Pepero Day（品pero节），这是韩国最生动、最有趣的非正式节日之一。Pepero最初由Lotte Wellfood于1983年推出，如今已从简单的品牌名称发展为家喻户晓的代名词，在这里泛指所有细长的饼干棒。如今，这项传统已演变成一场全国性的友谊、浪漫与爱意庆典，互赠Pepero饼干棒是向在意的人表达关心的最佳方式。无论你想找一款经济快捷的小零食，还是一份奢华的手工礼物，以下是畅享Pepero Day（品pero节）的完整指南。参与韩国这项最受欢迎的11月传统活动，无需花费太多钱。11月11日前，韩国主要便利店连锁店——CU、GS25、7-Eleven和Emart24——会用巨型Pepero展示装点店面。每盒售价1,500韩元至2,000韩元（约1.1至1.5美元），消费者可以尝遍从怀旧经典款到季节限定款的丰富产品。产品阵容以经典的原味巧克力棒开篇，它采用标志性的红色包装，将纤细酥脆的饼干裹上简单的牛奶巧克力。对于偏爱更浓郁口感的人，绿色包装的杏仁口味外层覆盖巧克力和碎烤坚果，依然广受欢迎。在 neighbourhood 便利店里灯火通明的货架上，满满当当地摆着批量生产的红色包装产品；与此同时，首尔时尚精品商圈每年11月还会形成一种更安静、更讲究的传统。延南洞、汉南洞和江南等街区的手工巧克力匠人与独立烘焙店，把朴素的量产饼干棒变成升级版美食画布。糕点师不用工厂挤压成型的饼干底，而是手工擀制黄油丰润的沙布蕾面团、酥脆的猫舌饼干或精致的椒盐脆饼棒。这些饼干底会被烘焙至恰到好处的酥脆程度，再裹上单一产地黑巧克力、烘焙抹茶巧克力或 creamy 白巧克力。位于城东区圣水洞的Soso Baking是一家在社交媒体上凭借视觉效果走红的新潮甜品工作室，推出酥脆却湿润的Pepero式菲纳ancier 糕点等独特创作。你也可以像当地人一样庆祝Pepero Day（品pero节）：早晨散步时从街角便利店买上几盒经典款，带去送给同事、同学，或早晨为你冲咖啡的咖啡师。一路上 cheerful 地送上一句“Pepero Day（品pero节）快乐！”并把这些美味分给大家，表达爱意就是这么简单

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body: Seoul's push to become a global artificial intelligence (AI) hub translated into millions of dollars in potential business opportunities after its pavilion at one of the world's largest smart city exhibitions generated $3.52 million (about 4.7 billion won) in export consultations. The Seoul AI Foundation said Monday that its Seoul pavilion at Smart City Expo World Congress 2026, held Nov. 3-5 at Fira Barcelona Gran Via in Barcelona, recorded 398 business consultations worth that amount. The approximately 180-square-meter pavilion featured companies specializing in energy, urban safety, mobility and spatial information, showcasing AI solutions designed to address urban challenges. Gangnam District also operated a separate exhibition space under the slogan “Gangnam, Smarter With AI,” joined by five companies based in the district or involved in pilot projects there. Each participating company recorded an average of 36 business consultations, up from 32 last year, while average consultation value reached $320,000, compared with approximately $300,000 in 2025. The exhibition also featured the sixth Smart City Seoul Forum on Wednesday, bringing together domestic and international experts to discuss applying AI policies to public services, urban safety and city governance. Foundation Chairman Kim Man-ki said the real value of AI lay in creating opportunities through technology. “Ultimately, the AI city that Seoul envisions is a city with a high density of opportunities, where citizens and businesses encounter more possibilities,” Kim said. The foundation said it would expand international partnerships through Seoul Smart Life Week and help local technology companies pursue overseas business opportunities. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.title_zh: 首尔人工智能馆在巴塞罗那博览会上创造352万美元出口机会
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body_zh: 首尔积极推动成为全球人工智能（AI）中心，其在世界上规模最大的智慧城市展览之一的展馆促成价值数百万美元的商业机会。首尔人工智能基金会周一表示，在11月3日至5日于巴塞罗那Fira Barcelona Gran Via举行的Smart City Expo World Congress 2026上，首尔展馆共促成398场商业洽谈，洽谈金额达352万美元（约合47亿韩元）。这座约180平方米的展馆汇集了能源、城市安全、出行和空间信息等领域的专业公司，展示旨在应对城市挑战的人工智能解决方案。江南区还以“江南，与AI一起更智慧”为口号 operate 了一个独立展区，5家总部位于该区或在当地参与试点项目的公司参展。每家参展公司平均促成36场商业洽谈，高于去年的32场；平均洽谈金额达到32万美元，而2025年约为30万美元。展览还于周三举办第六届Smart City Seoul Forum，汇聚国内外专家，讨论如何将人工智能政策应用于公共服务、城市安全和城市治理。基金会理事长金万基表示，人工智能的真正价值在于通过技术创造机会。金说：“归根结底，首尔所设想的人工智能城市是一座机会密度极高的城市，市民和企业能够在这里遇见更多可能。”该基金会表示，将通过Seoul Smart Life Week拓展国际合作，并帮助本地科技公司开拓海外商业机会。本文在生成式人工智能协助下刊登，并由《韩国时报》编辑

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Cho Young-soo, chair emeritus of the Hansae Yes24 Foundation, has received a commendation from the Seoul mayor for her charitable donations and humanitarian work, the foundation said on Monday. Cho served as chairwoman of the foundation for five years beginning in 2018. “I will continue to reach out to those in need and contribute to building a society where we live together.” The foundation was established in 2014 with personal funding from Kim Dong-nyung, chairman of Hansae Yes24 Holdings.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 韩星Yes24基金会名誉主席赵容秀因慈善捐赠和人道主义工作，荣获首尔市长表彰，该基金会周一表示。赵容秀自2018年起担任该基金会主席，任职5年。她说：“我将继续帮助有需要的人，并为建设一个共同生活的社会作出贡献。”该基金会由韩星Yes24控股公司董事长金东龙个人出资，于2014年成立。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Cho Young-soo, chair emeritus of the Hansae Yes24 Foundation, has received a commendation from the Seoul mayor for her charitable donations and humanitarian work, the foundation said on Monday. The Korean Red Cross recommended Cho for the honor, citing her sustained support for humanitarian causes, including a donation of 100 million won ($73,000) in July, according to the foundation. The donation also brought her into the Red Cross Honors Club, a group of major donors to the organization. Beyond her work through the foundation, Cho has used personal funds to support organizations including the Community Chest of Korea, Seoul National University and the Korean Red Cross, the foundation said. Her contributions also include support for students and younger generations as a senior figure in education. The foundation said those activities, alongside her donations, formed part of the basis for the commendation. Cho served as chairwoman of the foundation for five years beginning in 2018. During her tenure, she led programs supporting academic research, scholarships for international students, and cultural and artistic activities. The foundation cited both Cho’s personal giving and her leadership of its public service programs in announcing the award. “I am grateful to receive such a meaningful award, but I also feel a great sense of responsibility,” Cho said. “I will continue to reach out to those in need and contribute to building a society where we live together.” The foundation was established in 2014 with personal funding from Kim Dong-nyung, chairman of Hansae Yes24 Holdings. It operates academic and cultural programs aimed at expanding exchanges between Korea and Southeast Asia. Its activities include international cultural exchange exhibitions, support for humanities research, and the translation and publication of Southeast Asian literature. These initiatives form part of its broader works supporting academic and cultural activities in Korea and abroad
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 韩沙逸 Yes24 基金会主席获慈善表彰
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: Hansae Yes24 Foundation名誉理事长赵英淑因慈善捐赠和人道主义工作，荣获首尔市长表彰。该基金会周一表示，韩国红十字会推荐赵英淑获得这一荣誉，并称她长期支持人道主义事业，包括今年7月捐赠1亿韩元（$73,000）。这笔捐赠还使她加入红十字会荣誉俱乐部，该俱乐部由向该组织提供大额捐赠的人士组成。基金会表示，除通过基金会开展的工作外，赵英淑还动用个人资金支持包括韩国社区 Chest、首尔大学和韩国红十字会在内的机构。作为教育界资深人士，她的捐助还包括支持学生和年轻一代。基金会表示，这些活动连同她的捐赠，构成了此次表彰的依据。赵英淑自2018年起担任该基金会理事长，任职5年。任期内，她主持了支持学术研究、为国际学生提供奖学金以及开展文化艺术活动的项目。基金会宣布授予赵英淑该奖项时，既提到她的个人捐赠，也赞扬她领导公共服务项目的工作。赵英淑说：“我很荣幸获得这样一份意义重大的奖项，但也感到肩负着重大责任。我会继续向有需要的人伸出援手，并为建设一个我们共同生活的社会作出贡献。”该基金会由Hansae Yes24 Holdings董事长Kim Dong-nyung以个人资金于2014年创办，致力于推动韩国与东南亚之间交流的学术和文化项目。其活动包括举办国际文化交流展览、支持人文学科研究，以及翻译和出版东南亚文学。这些举措是该基金会支持韩国国内外学术和文化活动整体工作的组成部分。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: School seeks to attract talented students from overseas The University of Seoul held an admissions information session at the University of Languages and International Studies of Vietnam National University, Hanoi, Oct. 30, as part of its efforts to attract talented students from overseas. The University of Seoul said the event drew approximately 360 participants, including students enrolled in Korean language departments at local Vietnamese universities. The information session was organized to introduce local students firsthand to the university’s academic strengths and admission procedures, while expanding its efforts to attract talented international students. Faculty members from six colleges and the university’s Korean Language and Culture Program engaged with local students and provided one-on-one consultations for students interested in studying in Korea. The six colleges were the College of Political Science and Economics, the College of Business Administration, the College of Humanities, the College of Natural Sciences, the College of Artificial Intelligence and Convergence and the College of Engineering. By having its faculty members directly introduce the university’s academic and research strengths, the university expects the event to help attract talented students from overseas and promote international exchange. Consultation booths were set up for each college, allowing students to get answers to their questions about preparing to study in Korea, including admission procedures and the distinctive features of individual academic programs. The university said the event provided local students with an opportunity to explore practical pathways to studying in Korea and gain a better understanding of the university’s distinctive academic environment. “The university’s first standalone admissions information session will serve as more than a promotional event,” said Won Yong-kul, president of the university. “It will mark the beginning of broader efforts to attract talented students from Vietnam and other countries and strengthen international exchange.” He said the university will build diverse partnerships with local governments, universities and private institutions in Vietnam to promote long-term, sustainable exchanges that go beyond short-term results. The University of Seoul also participated in the Study in Korea Education Fair in Vietnam 2026, which was jointly organized by the National Institute for International Education and the Korean Education Center in Hanoi from Oct. 31 to Nov. 1. At the fair, which brought together more than 70 universities, the University of Seoul operated an information booth and offered consultations to provide prospective students with information on undergraduate and graduate admissions as well as Korean language training programs. The number of Vietnamese students studying in Korea nearly doubled from 37,940 in 2022 to 75,144 in 2025, according to the Korean Educational Development Institute. Meanwhile, 164 elementary and secondary schools in Vietnam offered Korean language courses in the 2025-26 academic year, with a total of 34,315 students enrolled, pointing to growing interest in studying in Korea
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 首尔大学在越南举行招生说明会
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 首尔大学寻求吸引海外优秀学生。10月30日，首尔大学在河内越南国家大学外国语大学举办招生说明会，旨在吸引海外优秀学生。首尔大学表示，此次活动吸引约360人参加，其中包括越南当地高校韩语专业的学生。此次说明会旨在让当地学生第一手了解该校的学术优势和招生流程，同时扩大吸引优秀国际学生的力度。六所学院的教师以及该校韩国语言与文化项目人员与当地学生交流，并为有意赴韩国留学的学生提供一对一咨询。六所学院分别是政治与经济学院、经营大学院、人文学院、自然科学学院、人工智能与融合学院以及工学院。通过让教师直接介绍该校的学术与科研优势，首尔大学预计此次活动将有助于吸引海外优秀学生并促进国际交流。现场为各学院设置了咨询展位，让学生能够解答有关赴韩留学准备事项的疑问，包括招生流程和各专业项目的独特特点。首尔大学表示，此次活动为当地学生提供了探索赴韩留学实际路径的机会，使其更好地了解该校独特的学术环境。首尔大学校长 Won Yong-kul 表示：“首尔大学首次独立举办招生说明会，其意义将不止于宣传活动。这将标志着学校扩大 efforts 吸引越南及其他国家优秀学生、加强国际交流的开端。”他表示，学校将与越南地方政府、高校和私营机构建立多元化合作关系，推动超越短期成果的长期、可持续交流。首尔大学还参加了2026年越南韩国留学教育展。该展由 National Institute for International Education 与河内 Korean Education Center 于10月31日至11月1日联合举办。展览吸引了70多所大学参加，首尔大学在现场设立咨询展位并提供咨询，向准留学生介绍本科和研究生招生信息以及韩国语言培训项目。据 Korean Educational Development Institute 数据，在韩学习的越南学生人数从2022年的37,940人几乎翻了一番，2025年达到75,144人。与此同时，2025-26学年越南有164所中小学开设韩国语课程，共有34,315名学生选修，显示赴韩学习的兴趣日益增长

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 负债累累的韩国 broadcasters JTBC周一表示，计划于1月选定优先竞购方，并发布了拟议出售的正式公告。JTBC表示，将依照相关法律和重整法院程序，以“透明、公平”的方式进行出售。该 broadcaster 表示：“我们希望通过合并与收购，为增长建立可持续的基础，并增强内容和频道的竞争力。”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Debt-ridden Korean broadcaster JTBC plans to select a preferred bidder in January, the company said Monday, putting up its official notice for the envisioned sale. The sale will be conducted through an open competitive bidding process through the injection of external capital, EY Hanyoung, the accounting firm advising the sale, said in the notice. Potential bidders can submit their letter of intent over the next four weeks. JTBC said it will conduct the sale in a "transparent and fair" manner in accordance with relevant laws and rehabilitation court procedures. "Through the merger and acquisition, we hope to establish a sustainable base for growth and strengthen content and channel competitiveness," the broadcaster said. The sale notice came some two months after the Seoul Bankruptcy Court approved JTBC's request to begin rehabilitation proceedings in late August, allowing the company to restructure its debts under court supervision
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 陷入困境的JTBC拟于1月选定优先竞标方
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 负债累累的韩国 broadcasters JTBC表示，公司计划于1月遴选优选竞标人，并已就拟议中的出售发布正式公告。负责此次出售的会计师事务所安永汉永在公告中表示，此次出售将通过公开竞争性招标程序进行，并引入外部资本。潜在竞标人可在未来4周内提交意向书。JTBC表示，将依照相关法律和重整法院程序，以“透明、公平”的方式进行出售。该广播公司说：“我们希望通过合并与收购，为增长建立可持续的基础，并增强内容和频道的竞争力。”出售公告发布于首尔破产法院批准JTBC于8月下旬启动重整程序约两个月后；法院的批准使公司得以在法院监督下重组债务。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/huayou-seeki.title: Huayou, seeking control of Ghana’s Ewoyaa lithium mine, faces scrutiny over compensation delays in Congo
https://www.myjoyonline.com/huayou-seeki.summary: Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt, the Chinese company seeking to acquire Atlantic Lithium, the developer of Ghana’s Ewoyaa lithium mine, is facing scrutiny in the Democratic Republic of Congo over delayed compensation to communities affected by pollution from one of its subsidiaries. The development comes as Huayou advances its investment in Ghana’s proposed first lithium mine. The company has completed an agreement to acquire Elevra Lithium’s rights and interests in the Ewoyaa project and Ghana portfolio.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/huayou-seeki.summary_zh: 中国浙江华友钴业寻求收购加纳Ewoyaa锂矿开发商Atlantic Lithium，目前在刚果民主共和国受到审查，原因是其一家子公司污染给周边社区造成影响，却迟迟未支付赔偿。与此同时，华友钴业正在推进对加纳拟建的首座锂矿的投资。该公司已就收购Elevra Lithium在Ewoyaa项目及加纳资产组合中的权利和权益达成协议。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/huayou-seeki.body: Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt, the Chinese company seeking to acquire Atlantic Lithium, the developer of Ghana’s Ewoyaa lithium mine, is facing scrutiny in the Democratic Republic of Congo over delayed compensation to communities affected by pollution from one of its subsidiaries. Congo’s mines ministry said on November 6, 2026 that Congo Dongfang International Mining (CDM) remains obliged to pay $6 million to affected communities, despite financial difficulties and a suspension of its operations, Reuters reported . The development comes as Huayou advances its investment in Ghana’s proposed first lithium mine. Atlantic Lithium shareholders are scheduled to vote on the proposed takeover on December 14, following court approval. The Congo case concerns an industrial wastewater spill at CDM’s Lubumbashi operation in November 2025. According to the Congolese ministry, a basin intended to retain water had been used to store acidic solutions. The incident affected surrounding communities and prompted authorities to suspend the company’s operations for three months. Authorities subsequently required CDM to provide $2 million each to Kasapa, Kamatete and Kamisepe. A separate $6.6 million penalty was imposed for payment to the state treasury. However, implementation of the community compensation programme has been delayed. The ministry attributed the delays partly to financial difficulties cited by CDM, which recently announced that it had halted its activities. “Financial difficulties or the suspension of operations do not exempt the operator from its obligations toward affected populations,” the ministry said. For Ghana, the development draws attention to the environmental and community obligations of the group moving into Ewoyaa. Huayou’s involvement in the project is already progressing independently of its proposed acquisition of Atlantic Lithium. The company has completed an agreement to acquire Elevra Lithium’s rights and interests in the Ewoyaa project and Ghana portfolio. The proposed acquisition of Atlantic Lithium remains a separate transaction, subject to shareholder approval, regulatory approvals from Ghana’s Securities and Exchange Commission and the Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources, alignment with the Minerals Income Investment Fund, and the fulfilment of the remaining conditions. The Congo incident does not establish that similar problems will arise at Ewoyaa. It does, however, provide a record against which Ghanaian regulators and affected communities can examine the proposed investor’s environmental safeguards and arrangements for compensation. The issue extends beyond whether a company can finance a mine. It is also about whether its obligations to affected communities can be enforced when financial difficulties force it to suspend operations
https://www.myjoyonline.com/huayou-seeki.title_zh: 华友钴业寻求控制加纳Ewoyaa锂矿之际，因刚果补偿款延迟而受到审查
https://www.myjoyonline.com/huayou-seeki.body_zh: 寻求收购加纳Ewoyaa锂矿开发商Atlantic Lithium的中国公司Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt，正因旗下子公司污染影响社区后的赔偿支付延迟，在刚果民主共和国受到审查。据Reuters报道，刚果矿业部于2026年11月6日表示，尽管面临财务困难且已暂停运营，Congo Dongfang International Mining（CDM）仍有义务向受影响的社区支付600万美元。与此同时，Huayou正推进其对加纳拟建首座锂矿的投资。经法院批准后，Atlantic Lithium股东定于12月14日就拟议收购进行表决。刚果此案涉及CDM位于Lubumbashi的业务于2025年11月发生的工业废水泄漏事故。据刚果方面称，该公司的水坝原本用于蓄水，却被用来储存酸性溶液。事故影响了周边社区，并促使当局暂停该公司运营三个月。当局随后要求CDM分别向Kasapa、Kamatete和Kamisepe提供200万美元。此外，公司还被处以660万美元罚款，须向国库支付。然而，社区赔偿计划的执行一直延迟。该部将部分延误归因于CDM所称的财务困难；该公司最近宣布已停止业务。该部表示：“财务困难或暂停运营并不能免除运营方对受影响居民的义务。”对加纳而言，此事凸显Huayou进入Ewoyaa项目后所承担的环境和社区义务。即使不收购Atlantic Lithium，Huayou参与该项目的相关工作也已在推进。该公司已就收购Elevra Lithium在Ewoyaa项目及加纳资产组合中的权利和权益签署协议。拟议收购Atlantic Lithium仍是一项单独交易，须获得股东批准、加纳Securities and Exchange Commission及Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources的监管批准，符合Minerals Income Investment Fund的要求，并满足其余条件。刚果事件并不能证明Ewoyaa也会出现类似问题，但它留下了一份记录，供加纳监管机构和受影响社区据以审查拟议投资者的环保保障措施及赔偿安排。问题不仅在于一家公司能否为矿山融资，也在于当财务困难迫使其暂停运营时，其对受影响社区承担的义务能否得到强制执行

https://leadership.ng/federal-govt-pushe.title: Federal Govt Pushes Production-Driven Economy As Non-Oil Exports Hit $6.1bn
https://leadership.ng/federal-govt-pushe.summary: The Minister of State for Industry, Trade and Investment, Senator John Enoh, who represented President Bola Tinubu at the opening of the 40th Lagos International Trade Fair, said Nigeria must prioritise production if it intends to compete effectively in the global economy.
https://leadership.ng/federal-govt-pushe.summary_zh: 工业、贸易与投资部国务参议员 John Enoh 在第40届拉各斯国际贸易博览会开幕式上代表总统 Bola Tinubu 发表讲话。他表示，如果尼日利亚希望在全球经济中有效竞争，就必须优先发展生产。
https://leadership.ng/federal-govt-pushe.body: The Minister of State for Industry, Trade and Investment, Senator John Enoh, who represented President Bola Tinubu at the opening of the 40th Lagos International Trade Fair, said Nigeria must prioritise production if it intends to compete effectively in the global economy. Enoh, who spoke at the event held yesterday, said the country must move beyond buying and selling to producing goods that can compete in international markets, noting that sustainable economic growth depends on domestic production, value addition and job creation. According to him, Nigeria must sell to the world to avoid being at the mercy of the world. He said, “Trade without production is merely buying and selling other people’s work. True growth will only come when we make things, add value and employ people at home.” The minister disclosed that non-oil exports exceeded $6.1 billion in 2025, while capital importation reached approximately $21 billion within the same period, describing the figures as evidence of renewed confidence in the Nigerian economy. He said the figures presented an opportunity for the country to consolidate its economic reforms and strengthen the productive sectors. Enoh recalled that when the Tinubu administration assumed office in May 2023, it inherited an economy facing significant challenges, including a distorted foreign exchange market, depleted external reserves, rising inflation and the burden of fuel subsidy payments. He, however, said the government had embarked on reforms to address the structural challenges and reposition the economy for sustainable growth. Providing an update on the economy, he said Nigeria’s gross external reserves stood at approximately $55.07 billion as of October 2026, while net reserves exceeded $40 billion. He added that headline inflation had declined from above 34 per cent at its peak to 14.63 per cent in September 2026, while the economy recorded a growth rate of 4.43 per cent in the second quarter of 2026. The minister said the economic indicators reinforced the need to build a production-driven economy capable of generating employment, increasing exports and attracting sustainable investments. He linked the objectives to the theme of the 40th Lagos International Trade Fair, ‘Trade, Growth and Global Connection’, noting that the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) offered Nigeria access to a market of approximately 1.4 billion people. However, he said the country must improve product standards, accelerate customs clearance procedures and remove unnecessary trade barriers to take full advantage of the continental market. Enoh also highlighted the Nigeria Industrial Policy, recently approved by the Federal Executive Council, as a strategic framework for strengthening manufacturing, deepening local value chains and transforming the country’s raw materials into finished products. He said effective implementation of the policy would help Nigerian businesses improve their competitiveness and increase the country’s share of international trade. Also speaking, Lagos State Governor, Mr Babajide Sanwo-Olu, said the 40th edition of the trade fair should provide opportunities for businesses to secure buyers, attract investments and strengthen supply chains. Sanwo-Olu, who was represented at the event, said Lagos was committed to positioning itself as a major manufacturing and commercial hub, urging businesses to increase production, processing and value addition. With more than 1,000 exhibitors expected from over 20 countries, he said the fair would provide a platform for businesses to establish partnerships and explore opportunities across regional and international markets. The governor cited Lagos State’s first-place ranking in the 2025 Presidential Enabling Business Environment Council (PEBEC) Subnational Ease of Doing Business Report, where it scored 85.6 per cent. He also highlighted the Lagos State Industrial Policy 2025-2030 and the Lagos State Export Readiness Programme, which has supported 253 small and medium-scale enterprises to prepare their products for international markets. According to him, many micro, small and medium enterprises in the state have the products and determination to compete globally but require access to finance, technology and larger markets to realise their potential. He urged exhibitors to take advantage of the fair’s business-to-business and business-to-government platforms to establish commercial relationships and attract the investments required to expand their operations. In his remarks, President of the Lagos Chamber of Commerce and Industry (LCCI), Engr. Leye Kupoluyi, said the trade fair had, over the past 40 years, played a significant role in connecting producers with consumers and facilitating business relationships across industries and international borders. Kupoluyi said the Chamber was focused on ensuring that participation in the fair translated into tangible commercial partnerships, business expansion and stronger enterprises. He noted that Nigerian businesses had demonstrated resilience and resourcefulness despite operating in a challenging environment. However, he stressed that businesses required reliable infrastructure, affordable financing, efficient logistics, improved security and predictable government policies to expand production and compete effectively in domestic and international markets. https://leadership.ng/federal-govt-pushe.title_zh: 联邦政府推动生产驱动型经济，非石油出口额达到61亿美元
https://leadership.ng/federal-govt-pushe.body_zh: 尼日利亚工业、贸易与投资国务部长、参议员John Enoh代表总统Bola Tinubu出席第40届拉各斯国际贸易博览会开幕式时表示，如果尼日利亚想在全球经济中有效竞争，就必须优先发展生产。Enoh昨天在活动上表示，该国必须超越单纯的买卖，生产能够在国际市场竞争的商品，并指出，可持续经济增长取决于国内生产、增值转化和创造就业。据他介绍，尼日利亚必须向全球销售产品，才能避免受制于世界市场。他说：“没有生产的贸易不过是买卖他人的成果。只有当我们制造产品、实现增值并在国内雇佣人员时，才会实现真正的增长。”这位部长透露，2025年非石油出口额超过$6.1 billion，同期资本流入约为$21 billion，并称这些数字证明外界对尼日利亚经济的信心正在恢复。他说，这些数据为该国巩固经济改革、加强生产部门提供了机遇。Enoh回顾称， Tinubu政府于2023年5月上任时，继承的是一个面临重大挑战的经济体，包括扭曲的外汇市场、枯竭的外汇储备、不断攀升的通货膨胀以及燃油补贴支付带来的负担。然而，他表示，政府已经启动改革，以应对结构性挑战，并推动经济重新定位，为可持续增长奠定基础。在介绍经济最新情况时，他说，截至2026年10月，尼日利亚 gross external reserves约为$55.07 billion，净储备超过$40 billion。他补充说，总体通货膨胀率已从峰值时超过34 per cent降至2026年9月的14.63 per cent，而2026年第二季度经济增长率达到4.43 per cent。部长表示，这些经济指标进一步证明，尼日利亚需要建设一个以生产为驱动、能够创造就业、增加出口并吸引可持续投资的经济体。他把这些目标与第40届拉各斯国际贸易博览会的主题“贸易、增长与全球互联”联系起来，并指出，非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）让尼日利亚得以进入一个拥有约1.4 billion人口的市场。然而，他也表示，该国必须提高产品标准、加快海关清关程序并取消不必要的贸易壁垒，才能充分利用非洲大陆市场。Enoh还提到，联邦执行委员会最近批准的《尼日利亚工业政策》是一项战略框架，旨在加强制造业、深化本地价值链，并将该国原材料转化为成品。他说，有效落实这项政策将帮助尼日利亚企业提升竞争力，并提高该国在国际贸易中的份额。拉各斯州州长Babajide Sanwo-Olu先生也在会上表示，第40届贸易博览会应为企业寻找买家、吸引投资和加强供应链提供机会。Sanwo-Olu由代表出席活动，他说，拉各斯致力于把自己打造为重要的制造业和商业中心，敦促企业增加生产、加工和增值。届时预计将有来自20多个国家的1,000多家展商参展，他说，博览会将为企业在区域和国际市场建立合作关系、探索商机提供平台。州长援引了拉各斯州在2025年Presidential Enabling Business Environment Council（PEBEC）Subnational Ease of Doing Business Report中名列第一的成绩，该州得分为85.6 per cent。他还介绍了《拉各斯州工业政策2025-2030》和拉各斯州出口准备计划，后者已支持253家中小型 enterprises为国际市场准备产品。据他介绍，该州许多微、小和中型企业拥有能够在全球竞争的产品和决心，但仍需要获得融资、技术和更大的市场，才能充分发挥潜力。他敦促参展商利用博览会的企业对企业及企业对政府平台，建立商业关系并吸引扩大经营所需的投入。拉各斯商会及工业协会（LCCI）会长工程师Leye Kupoluyi在发言中表示，过去40年来，贸易博览会在连接生产者与消费者以及促进各行业和国际边界之间的商业关系方面发挥了重要作用。Kupoluyi表示，商会正努力确保参展能够转化为实实在在的商业合作伙伴关系、业务扩张和企业实力提升。他指出，尽管经营环境充满挑战，尼日利亚企业依然展现出韧性和应变能力。然而，他强调，企业需要可靠的基础设施、可负担的融资、高效的物流、更好的安全保障和可预期的政府政策，才能扩大生产并在国内和国际市场中有效竞争。掌握第一手动态。获取实时报道、独家爆料和独特视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。立即在WhatsApp上加入LEADERSHIP NEWS，随时随地获取全天候更新 →

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/the-.body: •Tinubu seeks $20.5bn; €1.04bn foreign loans to fund projects – Vanguard, October 28, 2026 Seldom do I find myself on the same side with former President Obasanjo on matters concerning national affairs. Right now, I am on all fours with Baba Iyabo with regard to his position on President Tinubu’s request for fresh loans amounting to over $21 billion or N29.4 trillion. The debt burden is now approximately N160 trillion. Given a shamelessly rubber stamp Senate, it is a foregone conclusion that it will be approved. By December, the total debt would total N189.4 trillion. It was about N100 trillion when Buhari left the nation’s “economy on the brink of bankruptcy” – according to Tinubu. Putting the request into historical perspective would help to understand the loan request better. From 1978, under General Obasanjo, when the first $2.8 billion loan was taken, it took the country 21 years until 1999 to accumulate $36 billion or N50.4 trillion at current exchange rates. Minister of Finance, Dr Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala got us out of the debt trap in 2004. By the time President Jonathan left office in 2015, the debt had risen to $30 billion or N42 trillion once again. Eight years of Buhari’s financial mismanagement racked up N58 trillion. By the time this fresh loan is approved and taken, Tinubu would have added N89.4 trillion in just three and a half years; and, this might not be the last loan request before May 29, 2027. Whoever is President next year might be facing a debt burden well over N200 trillion. When last year I wrote that borrowing is the opium of the governing classes, it never occurred to me that the addiction could be as bad as this. Obasanjo is absolutely correct; mindless borrowing, tainted with corrupt and concealed self-interest, is indeed worse than leprosy. Lepers sometimes have children without leprosy. The malady is invariably restricted to one person and one generation. Nigeria’s debt load, made infinitely worse by Tinubu’s fiscal policy mismanagement, is already visiting diseases more virulent than leprosy on millions of Nigerians alive; and will savage millions more for at least three generations for one inescapable reason – inability to repay from revenue generation. “Nigeria misses 10-month revenue target by N20.7tn” – Report, October 27, 2026. The report which must have been glossed over by most Nigerians, when taken in conjunction with a previous one which announced that debt repayment exceeded revenue collected, should raise alarm everywhere. Despite all the attempts to mislead Nigerians, the fact is; the Federal Government, FG, is living on borrowed funds. Nigeria is unable to pay its bills and repay loans, as and when due, without resorting to more loans. Like all addicts, this nation is hooked on loans and would suffer a major shock if borrowing stops. No nation develops rapidly by borrowing alone. That is a verdict of economic history which cannot be disputed. Another axiom of economics stipulates that governments must take the lead and determine the directions of growth and development; and not leave them to the haphazard and un-coordinated plans of the private sectors. Our current experience with the Dangote Refinery should serve as a lesson regarding what can happen when the government abdicates its role as the driver of the directions of growth to individual investors. Given unclear government guidelines with regard to production, pricing and distribution of fuel, Dangote is at liberty to export fuel – even when acute global scarcity induces high fuel prices locally. Consequently, the FG is forced to make promises which cannot be kept – reduced transport fares from October 1, more CNG vehicles, subsidized fuel for 30 days. Each failure reinforces distrust of government and makes it more difficult to stimulate support. Monetary policy management under the current Governor of the Central Bank of Nigeria, CBN, is the only aspect of the government which is encouraging foreign investors. The other areas of reform are not working so well – for the simple reason that fiscal policy management is falling short of expectations. Few people would have believed, until it happened, that Tinubu, a proclaimed accountant, would mismanage the annual budget worse than Buhari. Under Buhari, one year’s budget was extended by no more than six months. The 2025 Budget will run until December 2026; nobody is certain, if and when the 2024 Budget ended. Capital appropriations for 2024 and 2025 were less than five per cent of the amounts budgeted; and 2026 is already following the same pattern. Again, it has been demonstrated worldwide that rapid economic and social development is only possible with unrelenting infrastructural development. “LOANS: It’s not how much we borrow, but what we build – TINUBU” -Vanguard, October 30, 2026. Tinubu elaborated on that statement: “The real question is not how much we borrow, but what we build, what value we create and what future we leave behind.” The statement is half true and half untrue. Obasanjo called it “nonsense”. I won’t go that far. Tinubu is absolutely correct when he asserted that “it is not how much we borrow but how much we build”. His references to the Lagos-Calabar, Sokoto-Badagry and Trans-Sahara highways exposed the weakness in his defence. Highways – Sokoto-Badagry for example – have been started before and abandoned later. The Sokoto-Badagry road, in particular, brings painful memories to my family. Started by Obasanjo in the mid-1970s, my immediate senior brother, Adebowale Sobowale, working for Texaco, was killed on the road, under construction on November 25, 1978. It was abandoned shortly after Shagari became President. The fact that construction starts does not guarantee completion. Governor Jakande started monorail in Lagos; Buhari cancelled it; Shagari embarked on the Third Mainland Bridge; Buhari stopped it; Babangida completed it. The truth is: with long-term and expensive projects, nothing is certain until they are completed. Even completion does not ensure economic feasibility or financial viability. Labour Transport, bank-rolled by the FG when Oshiomohle was President, never returned a kobo on investment. Over thirty airports and airstrips exist in Nigeria; only four are viable. The FG is now busy acquiring those disasters. Mere existence will not transform Kogi or Nasarawa airports to investment from absolute waste of public funds. Clearly, you can build; but “what we build” might constitute a heavier debt burden than a profitable investment creating jobs and increasing national wealth. We have seen it happen before. The Nigerian Airways was established with the intention of projecting the country abroad, creating jobs and making money as well. It ended in receivership, wiped out jobs and impoverished some of its creditors. All the governments involved in all those failed enterprises also once thought of “what future we leave behind”. Go to Ajaokuta and see what previous FGs left behind. My real fear is this; given a government addicted to debt, and given the addict’s habit of spending every kobo at hand, the new loan might not even be spent on the projects stated.
