https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/the-.title_zh: 不断加重的债务负担应令尼日利亚人深感恐惧——Dele Sobowale撰文
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/the-.body_zh:
•蒂努布寻求205亿美元、10.4亿欧元外国贷款，为项目提供资金——Vanguard，2026年10月28日。

在关乎国家事务的问题上，我很少与前总统奥巴桑乔站在同一边。眼下，对于总统蒂努布寻求总额超过210亿美元、即29.4万亿奈拉新贷款的立场，我完全赞同Baba Iyabo。债务负担如今约为160万亿奈拉。鉴于参议院会毫无原则地予以批准，贷款获批已是板上钉钉。到12月，债务总额将增至189.4万亿奈拉。据蒂努布称，布哈里卸任时，这个国家正处于“经济濒临破产的边缘”，当时债务约为100万亿奈拉。回顾历史，有助于更好地理解此次贷款申请。1978年，奥巴桑乔将军执政时期，国家首次借入28亿美元贷款，此后用了21年，到1999年才累计欠下360亿美元，按当前汇率折合50.4万亿奈拉。财政部长恩戈齐·奥孔乔-伊维阿拉博士在2004年帮助我们摆脱了债务陷阱。2015年乔纳森总统卸任时，债务再次升至300亿美元，即42万亿奈拉。布哈里执政八年的财政管理不善，累计造成58万亿奈拉债务。此次新贷款获批并借出后，短短三年半内，蒂努布就会新增89.4万亿奈拉债务；而且，这可能不是截至2027年5月29日之前的最后一次贷款申请。明年无论谁出任总统，都可能面对远超200万亿奈拉的债务负担。

去年我曾写道，借贷是统治阶级的鸦片，我当时没想到，这种瘾头会严重至此。奥巴桑乔完全正确；这种不负责任的借贷掺杂着腐败且被掩盖的自私利益，确实比麻风病更糟。麻风病人有时还会生下没有麻风病的孩子，而这种疾病始终局限于一个人、一代人。蒂努布财政政策管理不善使尼日利亚的债务负担雪上加霜，如今正在给数百万仍然活着的尼日利亚人带来比麻风病更凶险的灾难；并且至少还会蹂躏未来三代人，其原因无法回避——国家无法依靠创造财政收入来偿还债务。

“尼日利亚财政收入未达10个月目标，缺口20.7万亿奈拉”——Report，2026年10月27日。这份报告想必被大多数尼日利亚人轻描淡写地忽略了，但它与此前一份宣布偿债支出超过已征得收入的报告结合起来看，理应引起各方警觉。尽管有人想方设法误导尼日利亚人，事实仍是：联邦政府，即FG，靠借来的资金维持运转。尼日利亚无法按期支付各项账单和偿还贷款，只能继续举债。

和所有瘾君子一样，这个国家已经离不开贷款，一旦停止借款，必将遭受严重冲击。没有任何国家能仅靠借债实现快速发展。这是经济史给出的无可争辩的结论。经济学还有一条公理：政府必须发挥带头作用，确定增长与发展的方向，不能把这些问题丢给私营部门随意且缺乏协调的计划。我们目前在Dangote炼油厂的经历，就应当成为一项教训，说明当政府放弃充当增长方向推动者的职责、把方向交给个别投资者时，可能发生什么。由于政府就燃料生产、定价和分销没有明确指引，Dangote可以自由出口燃料，即便全球性严重短缺已导致国内燃油价格飙升。因此，FG被迫作出无法兑现的承诺——从10月1日起降低交通票价、增加压缩天然气汽车、为期30天补贴燃油。每一次失败都会加深公众对政府的不信任，也使争取支持更加困难。

在尼日利亚中央银行，即CBN现任行长领导下，货币政策管理是政府工作中唯一令外国投资者感到鼓舞的领域。其他领域的改革效果不佳，原因很简单：财政政策管理未达到预期。很少有人会相信，自诩为会计师的蒂努布在年度预算管理上的表现会差于布哈里，而且是在事情实际发生后才会相信。布哈里执政时，一年的预算最多延长执行六个月；2025年预算将一直执行到2026年12月，而2024年预算究竟何时结束都无人确定。2024年和2025年的资本支出均不到预算金额的5%；2026年又在重演同样的模式。

世界各地再次证明，经济的快速发展和社会进步只有伴随持续不断的基础设施建设才可能实现。

“贷款：重要的不是我们借了多少，而是我们建设了什么——蒂努布”——Vanguard，2026年10月30日。

蒂努布进一步阐述了这番话：“真正的问题不是我们借了多少，而是我们建设了什么、创造了什么价值，以及我们会给后人留下什么未来。”这句话一半正确，一半错误。奥巴桑乔称其为“胡说”。我不会说得这么重。蒂努布断言“重要的不是我们借了多少，而是我们建设了多少”时，确实完全正确。但他提及拉各斯—卡拉巴尔、索科托—巴达吉里和跨撒哈拉高速公路，却暴露了其辩护中的弱点。

高速公路——比如索科托—巴达吉里高速公路——过去也曾开工，后来却被放弃。尤其是索科托—巴达吉里公路，给我的家庭带来了痛苦回忆。该路由奥巴桑乔于20世纪70年代中期开工。我的直属兄长Adebowale Sobowale当时供职于Texaco，他于1978年11月25日在这条仍在施工的公路上丧生。沙加里就任总统后不久，该工程便被放弃。

开工并不意味着工程一定能够完工。Jakande州长在拉各斯启动单轨铁路，布哈里将其取消；沙加里着手修建第三大陆桥，布哈里又叫停；巴班吉达最终将其完成。事实是，对于工期长、成本高的项目，在竣工之前，一切都无法确定。即便竣工，也不保证其经济可行性或财务盈利能力。

Oshiomohle任总统期间由FG出资支持的Labour Transport，投资从未收回一个Kobo。尼日利亚有30多座机场和 airstrip，但只有四座具备运营可行性。FG如今正忙于收购这些灾难性资产。仅仅拥有这些设施，并不能把Kogi或Nasaraw机场从公共资金被彻底浪费的败笔变成有价值的投资。

显然，你当然可以建设；但“我们建设了什么”可能意味着比创造就业、增加国家财富的盈利性投资更沉重的债务负担。这样的事以前已经发生过。Nigerian Airways成立的宗旨，是将国家形象投射到海外、创造就业并实现盈利。最终它陷入破产管理，岗位被消灭，一些债权人因此陷入贫困。所有参与这些失败企业的政府，也都曾想过“我们会给后人留下什么未来”。去Ajaokuta看看历届FG留下了什么。

我真正担心的是：鉴于政府已经对债务上瘾，又染上瘾君子把手头每一个Kobo都花光的习惯，这笔新贷款甚至可能不会用于所宣称的项目。

本文表达的看法不代表Vanguard报社或其任何员工的意见。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110910.body_zh: （益山=韩联社）金진방记者报道：全北益山市长崔正浩为应对国会预算决算特别委员会对下一年度政府预算案的审议，连续两周三度到访国会，展开密集活动。崔市长于9日访问国会，先后会见掌握预算案审议关键预算决算委员会所属主要议员和常任委员会中的中生议员，请求国家预算追加反映并增加对地区核心项目的投入。由于政府预算案削减和增额最终决定的预算决算委员会综合政策质询及各部门审议集中在11月上旬和中旬进行，这体现了力争让地区悬而未决事项尽可能多地得到反映的战略考量。当天，崔市长依次拜访了包括预算决算委员会委员郑泰浩在内的尹俊彬议员、郑成浩议员、韩炳铎民主劳动党院内代表等国会核心人士，逐一说明按项目获得国家资金支持的必要性。首先，在未来尖端新产业领域，他提议建设以实体智能AI为基础的AAR（自主飞行机器人）国家产业集群、建设动物用药品生物工厂、培育绿色生物科技初创企业项目，以及建设半导体材料化学传感器实证中心等。此外，为提升地区特色产业水平，他建议建设食品科技地区创新集群公共基础设施和石材产业支持中心，恳请国家为韩国食品之都和石材产业的再腾飞提供支持。他还请求国家支持交通网络项目，包括建设连接“五极三特”的区域交通枢纽、增加国道27号替代绕城道路（西水至平章）建设项目资金，以及开建东益山站进出道路。崔市长表示：“国会预算审议正处于国家资金增额与削减相互交错的阶段，脚步越频繁，地区未来预算就会越充裕。在成为益山未来增长动力的核心项目最终通过国会全体会议之前，我会不断敲门并尽力说服。”报道可通过KakaoTalk okjebo联系。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载或再分发，禁止用于AI学习及运用。2026/11/09 14:42发布，2026年11月9日14时42分发布。

人民党（AAP）于2026年11月9日星期一上午，批评德里人民党（BJP）政府通过关闭空气质量监测站，指控其操纵空气质量数据。德里人民党主席Saurabh Bharadwaj在一段发布于X平台的视频中问道：“这个政府在排灯节之夜关闭空气质量监测站，进行数据欺诈，你们怎能信任这样的政府？”

据官方数据，在德里居民超过最高法院为排灯节之夜规定的晚上10时这一时限燃放鞭炮后，部分地区的PM2.5浓度飙升至世界卫生组织（WHO）建议的24小时标准的66倍，随后在2026年11月9日星期一凌晨逐渐下降。然而，在2026年11月8日星期日夜晚燃放鞭炮后污染达到峰值期间，由德里政府旗下德里污染控制委员会（DPCC）运营的多个监测站数据有数小时无法获取。这意味着实际污染峰值可能更高。

Bharadwaj先生表示：“政府正在公开进行欺诈。我们曾就数据操纵问题致函CAQM和CPCB（中央污染控制委员会）。但所有人都保持沉默。原因是所有人都参与了这场欺诈。”

上周，人民党曾指控人民党政府通过向监测站喷水来操纵空气质量数据，并称“篡改”空气质量数据不只是腐败问题，更会危及生命。该党上周还致函CAQM和CPCB，指控德里政府在首都操纵空气质量数据。

Rajiv Chowk clocked an AQI of 381 at 1:30 a.m., while the area surrounding South Extension registered an AQI of 360 at 4:00 a.m. Meanwhile, Delhi Minister Kapil Mishra launched a scathing attack on Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) national convenor Arvind Kejriwal, alleging that a campaign was being orchestrated at Mr. Kejriwal's residence to target the Hindu festival of Deepavali and Sanatan Dharma under the pretext of pollution. In a post on X, Mr. Mishra claimed that leaders and paid celebrities would be rolled out to run a targeted narrative. Stage III of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) is in force across Delhi-NCR. With Delhiites bursting firecrackers way past the 10 p.m. deadline set by the Supreme Court for Deepavali night, air pollution shot up to over 50 times World Health Organisation (WHO) limits in parts of the city, official data showed. The level of PM2.5 (a major pollutant) in Akshardham was 760.99 micrograms per cubic meter at 11 p.m. on Sunday (November 8, 2026), as per Delhi Pollution Control Committee (DPCC) data. This is about 50.73 times the WHO permissible limit of 15 micrograms per cubic meter for a 24-hour period. The Delhi Government, ahead of Deepavali, had appealed to people to comply with the Supreme Court’s directions on sale and use of green firecrackers. The top court, on November 2, while permitting the manufacture, sale, and bursting of approved firecrackers, subjected it to specific timings for Deepavali night and directed to restore the complete ban on November 9. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary: It is no longer news that the Republican Party lost the midterm elections in the US last week. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary_zh: 共和党上周在美国中期选举中失利，这已不再是什么新闻。由于美国现任总统的恶劣表现，这场失利本不该成为新闻；事实上，美国的中期选举很久以来就已变成对现任总统施政表现的全民公投。总统所属政党在最近22次中期选举中输了19次，这一事实正体现了其重要意义。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body: It is no longer news that the Republican Party lost the midterm elections in the US last week. It really ought not to have been newsworthy but for the toxic character of the incumbent president of the US midterm elections in America long since turned into plebiscites on the performance of the sitting president. This is the significance of the fact that the president’s party has lost in 19 of the last 22 midterm elections. But so horrible has Mr Trump been in office, that a different outcome would have been hard to explain. No surprise then, that pollsters called the outcome of the elections right this time. What about democracy? It remains “the worst form of Government except for all those other forms that have been tried from time to time…”, according to Winston Churchill. This is true of democracy in Serbia as it is in Brazil, and Hungary. Expectedly, Republicans will begin to struggle with Mr Trump’s legacy. Part of the effort will invest in dealing with the sharp ends of the pincer in which the Grand Old Party now finds itself pinched. This rock and hard place are described on one hand, by a lame duck president whose legacy the party’s would-be presidential candidates would want to increase their distance from and by Mr Trump’s hold on the party’s grassroots activists, which grants him a veto on party primaries, on the other. There is much irony in the latter, though. For in exercising this veto in the run up to Tuesday’s vote, Mr Trump put straw men up as his party’s candidates, and his MAGA movement proved too weak to lift any. The Democrats, too, may well find their victory a poisoned chalice. For, in truth, they did not win the midterm elections. Mr Trump, whose net approval rating at the beginning of last week was at its lowest in 80 years for any president at this phase of his four-year term, lost it. In other words, a party still struggling to find its voice after the debacle of then-President Joe Biden’s failed attempt at re-election in 2024 suddenly finds itself at the fore and centre of America’s policymaking. It will matter that their majority in Congress is not big enough to override a presidential veto. But given the many ways in which the party splintered after Kamala Harris’s loss to Mr Trump, on current form, the Democratic Party is likelier to tear itself apart from the inside in its battle to find answers to America’s many problems. The party’s slight shift to the left will not help matters. Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its promises and threats lend weight to concerns over the rising cost of living at the bottom of American society. Healthy economic growth (the envy of other rich economies, including China) coupled with inflation running ahead of wages invites questions about how to offer the mass of the people a leg up without dampening the animal spirits that drive the US’ stellar performance across sectors. Added to these troubles, is the fact that America has got to navigate this difficult path in a much-changed world. Donald Trump is hardly responsible for China’s emergence as a rival to America’s global leadership. The promises of a more harmonious global space following the end of the Cold War always sounded to good to be true. Nonetheless, Russia’s much lowered weight category (especially now that it is bent on punching above its weight), and America’s enhanced heft meant, at the very least, that the global institutions through which the world had managed itself since 1945 needed a face lift. A China with increased political and economic weight globally only makes this transition ever more urgent. Mr Trump’s genius was to do a successful Guy Fawkes on these institutions. America will have to spearhead their repair and rebuilding. Russia cannot. Neither can China or the EU. And middle powers? Tut-tut. But the US cannot do this all by itself. It helps that from the United Nations Organisation to NATO; these institutions have spent time reflecting on possible directions for change. Whatever these alternatives might be, the lessons from Russia’s invasion of and continued war on Ukraine and China’s never-ending threat to forcibly annex Taiwan suggest that the route to a stable and economically resilient world does not pass through the whimsies and caprices of strongmen. If this is the main lesson from Mr Trump and Binyamin Netanyahu’s needless war against Iran, then building coalitions that strengthen individual choice over the tyranny of collectives in a way that preserves universal human values is the new task before anyone with a stake in managing the global economy. This is the challenge before the post-Trump era. And it is one that I doubt that either party in the US as currently put together, can rise up to. Uddin Ifeanyi , a journalist manqué and retired civil servant, can be reached @IfeanyiUddin . Mr. Udin is Business Intelligence expert. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title_zh: 美国中期选举能带来哪些启示？——Uddin Ifeanyi撰文
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body_zh:
共和党上周在美国中期选举中败选，这已不再是什么新闻。其实，这一结果本不该成为新闻；但美国总统中期选举在美国由来已久，早已演变成对现任总统政绩的全民公投。总统所属政党在过去22次中期选举中有19次败选，这一事实的意义正在于此。然而，特朗普先生任职以来的表现实在糟糕，因此若出现另一种结果，反而难以解释。所以，这次民调人士准确预测了选举结果，也不足为奇。

那么，民主制度怎么样？根据温斯顿·丘吉尔的说法，民主仍是“除其他一切不时尝试过的政体之外，最坏的政府形式……”。这一评价适用于塞尔维亚，也适用于巴西和匈牙利。不出所料，共和党人将开始努力应对特朗普先生留下的政治遗产。其中一部分工作，是设法应对这个 venerable 政党如今深陷的两难夹击。一方面，它面对的是一名跛脚鸭总统；该党的潜在总统候选人都会希望与这位总统的政治遗产保持更远距离。另一方面，特朗普先生掌控着该党基层活动人士，这赋予他对党内初选否决权。

不过，后一方面颇具讽刺意味。因为在周二投票前夕动用这项否决权时，特朗普先生为该党推出的候选人都只是稻草人，而他的“MAGA”运动也过于弱势，未能将任何候选人推上选票。民主党同样可能发现，这场胜利其实是一杯毒酒。

事实上，他们并没有赢得中期选举。败选的是特朗普先生。就在上周初，他的净支持率达到任何总统在四年任期这一阶段80年来的最低水平。换言之，这个党在时任总统乔·拜登2024年竞选连任失败后仍在艰难寻找方向，如今却突然站到了美国政策制定的核心位置。其在国会的多数席位不足以推翻总统否决权，这会产生影响。但鉴于该党在卡玛拉·哈里斯败给特朗普先生后四分五裂的诸多表现，以当前态势看，民主党在寻找应对美国诸多问题答案的过程中，更可能从内部撕裂自己。该党略向左转的倾向无助于改善局势。

人工智能及其承诺与威胁，加剧了人们对美国社会底层生活成本上涨的担忧。健康的经济增长令包括中国在内的其他富裕经济体艳羡不已，但通胀跑在工资前面，也引出了一个问题：如何在不削弱推动美国在各行业卓越表现的那种活力与冲劲的同时，让广大民众的生活水平得到提升？

除此之外，美国还必须在一个已发生巨变的世界中走过这条艰难的道路。中国崛起为美国全球领导地位的竞争者，这很难说是唐纳德·特朗普的责任。冷战结束后构建更和谐全球空间的承诺，听上去始终美得不像是真的。尽管如此，俄罗斯的重量级身份已大幅下降（尤其是在它如今执意要超出自身分量行事的情况下），而美国分量增强，这至少意味着，自1945年以来世界赖以管理自身事务的全球机构需要整装更新。中国在全球的政治和经济分量增加，只会让这一转型更加紧迫。

特朗普先生的高明之处，在于他对这些机构成功发动了一次“盖伊·福克斯式”破坏。美国将不得不带头修复和重建这些机构。俄罗斯做不到，中国和欧盟也做不到。那么中等强国呢？恕我直言，也无济于事。

但美国无法独自完成这一切。所幸，从联合国组织到北约，这些机构已经花时间思考了可能的改革方向。无论这些方案可能是什么，俄罗斯入侵乌克兰并持续发动战争，以及中国从未停止以武力吞并台湾的威胁，都表明，通往稳定且具有经济韧性的世界的道路，并不经过强人的任性妄为和反复无常。

如果说，这是从特朗普先生和本雅明·内塔尼亚胡对伊朗发动的无谓战争中得出的主要教训，那么，以一种能够维护普遍人类价值的方式建立联盟，加强个人选择、抵制集体主义暴政，便成了所有参与全球经济治理者面临的新任务。这就是后特朗普时代摆在面前的挑战。而我怀疑，美国目前松散拼凑起来的任何一个政党都无力承担这一挑战。

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: Over 31,000 devotees and visitors thronged the Tawang Monastery in Arunachal Pradesh over seven days to pay their respects to the sacred relics of Shakyamuni Buddha, as an exposition concluded on Saturday, marking the end of its first leg in the Himalayan state. The sacred relics arrived in Tawang on October 31 from the National Museum in New Delhi before being transported to Bomdila by the Indian Air Force on November 8 for the next phase of the exposition. They will remain open for public darshan at TGL Monastery (Lower Gompa) until November 13. After Bomdila, the sacred relics will be taken to the Golden Pagoda in Namsai, where devotees can seek blessings from November 14 to 20. They are scheduled to be taken back to the National Museum on November 21. The initiative is part of the Union government’s efforts to promote India’s Buddhist heritage and strengthen cultural and spiritual ties with Buddhist communities across the world. The exposition was organised by the Union ministry of culture in collaboration with the Arunachal Pradesh government and the International Buddhist Confederation (IBC). Chief minister Pema Khandu ceremonially received the relics on their arrival in Tawang in the presence of Union culture and tourism minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat. A steady stream of Buddhist monks and devotees from Tawang and neighbouring areas thronged the seven-day event. Khandu inaugurated two exhibitions at Tawang Monastery. The first, titled ‘Unearthing the Sacred Piprahwa: The Story of the Holy Buddha Relics and Their Discovery’, organised by the IBC, traced the discovery of the Piprahwa relics in 1898. The second exhibition, ‘Crossroads of Dhamma: Classical Legacies, Living Art, and Anthropological Perspectives’, curated by the National Museum, showcased Buddhism’s historical, artistic and cultural legacy. An international conference, titled ‘Buddhism: Dissemination in the Himalayan Region and Beyond’, at the Kalawangpo Convention Centre was held on November 2. Buddhist scholars, religious leaders and representatives from other countries discussed the spread and preservation of Buddhist teachings and heritage

https://www.myjoyonline.com/without-medi.summary: Economic policies mean little to citizens if they do not understand them, Dr Johnson Asiama, Governor of the Bank of Ghana (BoG), said, describing the media as an essential partner in promoting public understanding of economic developments. Dr Asiama was speaking at the 30th Ghana Journalists Association (GJA) Media Awards on Saturday, noting that the Central Bank could not carry out its mandate in isolation from the media and professional journalists.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/without-medi.summary_zh: 加纳银行（BoG）行长 Johnson Asiama 博士表示，如果公民不了解经济政策，这些政策对他们就毫无意义；并将媒体称为推动公众了解经济发展不可或缺的合作伙伴。Asiama 博士于周六出席第30届加纳记者协会（GJA）媒体奖颁奖活动并发表讲话，指出中央银行无法脱离媒体和职业记者独立履行其职责。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/without-medi.body: Economic policies mean little to citizens if they do not understand them, Dr Johnson Asiama, Governor of the Bank of Ghana (BoG), said, describing the media as an essential partner in promoting public understanding of economic developments. Financial sector reforms, often technical and complex, could gain public trust only if journalists explained them in simple terms, including who benefited, what changed, and how citizens could protect their money. Professional journalism, he said, served as society’s compass, helping the public distinguish facts from falsehoods and deepen their understanding of monetary policy, inflation, exchange rates, financial sector reforms, and digital finance. Dr Asiama was speaking at the 30th Ghana Journalists Association (GJA) Media Awards on Saturday, noting that the Central Bank could not carry out its mandate in isolation from the media and professional journalists. “Our policies are most effective when they are clearly understood by the public. Transparency, credibility, and accountability require open and effective engagement with all stakeholders, including the media,” Dr Asiama said. He said the growing partnership between the Central Bank and the media had led to the establishment of the Governor’s Economic and Financial Story of the Year Award to encourage high-quality reporting and deepen public understanding of economic issues. “Our objective is simple: to invest in the development of journalists who can continue to elevate the quality of economic and financial reporting in Ghana,” the Governor said. At the just-ended GJA Media Awards, Ms Esther Aidoo of the Ghana Broadcasting Corporation (GBC) won the Governor’s Economic and Financial Story of the Year Award. The award package includes sponsorship to attend the International Monetary Fund (IMF)/World Bank Group (WBG) Spring or Annual Meetings, a laptop, a one-year internet data subscription, and opportunities for fellowships and scholarships for further studies. Dr Asiama said the Bank’s decisions affected every household, business, and market in the country, adding that accurate reporting helped Ghanaians understand why interest rates and prices changed and how the Bank worked to maintain economic stability. He said improved economic understanding not only benefited the Bank but also empowered citizens to save better, borrow wisely, invest carefully and hold institutions accountable, thereby strengthening financial literacy. On digital finance, he said the media played a crucial role in promoting safe adoption by educating the public on mobile money, digital payments, fraud risks, and consumer rights, especially as millions of Ghanaians increasingly conducted financial transactions without visiting bank branches. Dr Asiama acknowledged that technological advancements have transformed how information is created, distributed, and consumed, giving citizens more opportunities to participate in public discussions and share information. However, he said the same technologies had contributed to the spread of misinformation, disinformation, online abuse, misleading data and hate speech. “As guardians of public discourse, journalists are essential for building social unity, encouraging well-informed discussions, and safeguarding democratic principles,” he said. He urged journalists and media professionals to go beyond headlines and sensationalism and pursue depth, accuracy and context to ensure that economic reporting informed decisions rather than fuelled fear and confusion. Dr Asiama reaffirmed the Bank’s commitment to working closely with the media, saying the partnership was not a favour to journalists but a necessity for a stable, transparent and inclusive economy. The 30th GJA Media Awards were held on the theme: “Celebrating Excellence, Advancing Media Freedom and Combating Hate Speech in the Digital Age,” with stakeholders emphasising the need to protect press freedom while promoting responsible journalism
https://www.myjoyonline.com/without-medi.title_zh: 没有媒体，经济政策对公民而言毫无意义
https://www.myjoyonline.com/without-medi.body_zh: 加纳银行（BoG）行长Johnson Asiama博士表示，如果民众不理解经济政策，这些政策对民众而言就毫无意义。他称，媒体是推动公众了解经济发展不可或缺的合作伙伴。金融部门改革往往专业而复杂，只有当记者用简单直白的语言加以解释，包括说明谁从中受益、发生了哪些变化，以及公民如何保护自己的钱，这些改革才能赢得公众信任。他说，专业新闻业是社会的指南针，能够帮助公众区分事实与谬误，加深他们对货币政策、通货膨胀、汇率、金融部门改革和数字金融的理解。Asiama博士星期六在第30届加纳记者协会（GJA）媒体颁奖典礼上发表讲话时指出，中央银行不可能脱离媒体和职业记者单独履行其使命。Asiama博士说：“当公众清楚理解我们的政策时，这些政策才能发挥最大效力。透明度、可信度和问责制要求我们与包括媒体在内的所有利益相关方进行公开而有效的沟通。”他说，中央银行与媒体之间日益密切的合作促成了“行长年度经济与金融报道奖”的设立，以鼓励高质量报道，并加深公众对经济问题的理解。行长说：“我们的目标很简单：投资于记者的培养，使他们能够持续提升加纳经济与金融报道的质量。”在刚刚结束的第30届GJA媒体颁奖典礼上，加纳广播公司（GBC）的Esther Aidoo女士荣获“行长年度经济与金融报道奖”。奖项包括赞助参加国际货币基金组织（IMF）/世界银行集团（WBG）春季会议或年会、一台笔记本电脑、一年的互联网数据订阅，以及申请研究员项目和奖学金以进一步深造的机会。Asiama博士说，银行的决策影响着全国每一个家庭、企业和市场。他补充说，准确报道有助于加纳人了解利率和价格为何发生变化，以及银行如何努力维持经济稳定。他说，提升经济理解水平不仅有利于银行，也能赋予公民更好地储蓄、明智借贷、谨慎投资和监督机构的能力，从而增强金融素养。在数字金融方面，他说，媒体通过向公众普及移动货币、数字支付、欺诈风险和消费者权利，在推动安全使用方面发挥着关键作用，尤其是在数百万加纳人日益无需前往银行网点即可完成金融交易的情况下。Asiama博士承认，技术进步已经改变了信息的创作、传播和消费方式，为公民参与公共讨论和分享信息提供了更多机会。然而，他说，同等技术也助长了错误信息、虚假信息、网络滥用、误导性数据和仇恨言论的传播。他说：“作为公共话语的守护者，记者对于促进社会团结、鼓励知情的讨论以及捍卫民主原则至关重要。”他敦促记者和媒体从业者超越标题炒作和煽情报道，深入挖掘事实，确保准确性和语境，使经济报道能够为决策提供依据，而不是助长恐惧与困惑。Asiama博士重申，银行致力于与媒体密切合作，并表示这种合作并非对记者的恩惠，而是建立稳定、透明和包容性经济的必要条件。第30届GJA媒体颁奖典礼以“表彰卓越表现，推进媒体自由，遏制数字时代的仇恨言论”为主题，各利益相关方强调，在推动负责任新闻业的同时，必须保护新闻自由。

在建立了一个由实力更强的民族武装力量占据主导地位的新政治平台后，缅甸抵抗力量目前将重点转向情报工作。秘密行动已转向建立线人网络，并正在搭建联合情报框架。

孟加拉国、中国、印度和缅甸反对派都在争取争取民族武装首领丹·姆拉特·奈，其军队正在阿拉干邦与统治中的军政府作战。上述各方都在缅甸西部的这一地区拥有利益，并寻求为自身留后路，因为正在遭受阿拉干军攻击的实兑市命运仍不确定。

尽管缅甸内战持续，罗兴亚难民开始从孟加拉国拥挤的难民营返回若开邦。

中国国家安全部和中国人民解放军似乎正在策划一项计划的最后阶段，以保障中共在印度洋的关键利益。

在缅甸的欧洲雇佣兵（上）/下｜2023年10月27日，12名外国人在缅甸北部劳开附近被一个民族 rebel 组织俘获。这些人大多数是法国军团退役军人，但其中两人仍在服役。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/rive.body: Nyesom Wike, Minister of the Federal Capital Territory, FCT, said the people of Rivers State have chosen President Bola Tinubu as their candidate in the January 2027 presidential election. Wike said this on Saturday while welcoming Tinubu and his delegation to the Adokiye Amiesimaka Stadium in Port Harcourt for the president’s campaign rally. He is the coordinator of the presidential campaign council in the state. Wike said: “Your Excellency, this is Rivers State’s rally. We did not mobilise anybody from any other state. You can see with your eyes that the people of Rivers State have already concluded and agreed that on January 16, they will vote for you. “Since the inception of democracy in 1999, Rivers people have never had it this way. We have no less than 47 political appointments from Mr President. “So, who is our brother? Our brother is Bola Ahmed Tinubu because he has identified with the people of Rivers state. He described President Tinubu as a political ally of Rivers people, saying the president had demonstrated his commitment to the state through federal projects and political appointments. He questioned the outcome of an alleged fumigation exercise in Rivers, saying it had failed to eliminate mosquitoes. “All we are saying to the vice-presidential candidate is, please, come and give an account of how you fumigated Rivers state. You fumigated Rivers state so that there would be no mosquitoes. He recalled Amaechi’s role as director-general of the presidential campaigns of former President Muhammadu Buhari. Wike said the then APC candidate failed to secure up to 15 percent of the votes in Rivers state in the 2015 and 2019 presidential elections. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/rive.body_zh: 联邦首都 territory 部长 Nyesom Wike 表示，Rivers State 人民已经选择 Bola Tinubu 作为他们在 2027 年 1 月总统选举中的候选人。Wike 周六在 Port Harcourt 的 Adokiye Amiesimaka Stadium 欢迎 Tinubu 及其代表团出席总统竞选集会时说了这番话。他是该州总统竞选委员会协调员。Wike 说：“阁下，这是 Rivers State 的竞选集会。我们没有从其他任何州动员人手。您亲眼就能看到，Rivers State 人民已经作出决定并达成一致，他们将在 1 月 16 日投票支持您。‘自 1999 年民主制度建立以来，Rivers 人民从未像今天这样。我们从总统先生那里获得了不少于 47 项政治任命。‘那么，谁是我们的兄弟？我们的兄弟就是 Bola Ahmed Tinubu，因为他一直与 Rivers State 人民站在一起。’他将 Tinubu 总统形容为 Rivers 人民的政治盟友，称总统通过联邦项目和人事任命展示了对该州的承诺。他质疑了 Rivers 一次据称开展的灭蚊行动的结果，称其未能消灭蚊子。“我们对副总统候选人的全部要求就是，请他来说明自己是如何为 Rivers State 灭蚊的。他为 Rivers State 灭蚊，是为了让这里不再有蚊子。”他回顾了 Amaechi 担任前总统 Muhammadu Buhari 竞选活动总协调员的经历。Wike 说，当时 APC 候选人在 2015 年和 2019 年总统选举中均未能在 Rivers State 获得超过 15% 的选票。此处发表的意见不代表 Vanguard 报纸或其任何员工的观点

The S&P 500 added 0.31 percent, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq rose 1.09 percent. Investors are digesting fresh uncertainties surrounding Nvidia Corp. after the company announced it has launched an independent investigation into allegations its chief Jensen Huang was targeted by a Chinese spy. They are also closely following the moves from the Federal Reserve for cues on the next U.S. policy directions. Chip giant Samsung Electronics edged up 0.26 percent, while SK hynix inched down 0.09 percent. Carmaker Hyundai Motor shed 0.89 percent, defense giant Hanwha Aerospace fell 3.33 percent, and financial firm KB Financial declined 1.13 percent. https://www.myjoyonline.com/white-house-.body: US President Donald Trump's administration has vowed not to change course on its mass deportation plans after last week's midterm elections defeat. "This administration will not slow down its efforts to arrest and deport criminal illegal aliens who terrorise our communities," the White House said in a statement to the BBC. Trump's promotion on Friday of immigration hawk Stephen Miller to White House chief of staff had signalled no climbdown from the administration on border security. Exit polls indicate immigration was the third most important issue for midterm voters, after the economy and the state of democracy. In historically conservative states like Texas, a swing of Latino voters towards Democrats helped seal the party's landslide congressional majorities. But multiple US officials sources told the BBC's US partner CBS that the administration had put the midterm losses down to concerns about the economy, affordability and the war with Iran, rather than its immigration crackdown. The White House maintained on Sunday there would be no change of direction. "There has never been a President stronger on immigration enforcement than President Trump," said White House spokeswoman Lauren Bis. The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) also said it would forge ahead. "ICE is NOT backing away or slowing down," a DHS spokesperson told CBS. Following Tuesday's results, Vice-President JD Vance had appeared receptive to adjusting their immigration strategy. "I'm open to the idea that we should change enforcement - by focusing more on businesses that hire illegal labour, for instance," Vance wrote in a lengthy online post reflecting on the results. But the White House's posture appears to have hardened after Trump promoted Stephen Miller to chief of staff on Friday. Miller is widely seen as the architect of the administration's hardline immigration policy during the first and second Trump presidencies. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) sources told CBS that in recent weeks officials have been instructed to aim for about 2,700 arrests of illegal immigrants per day, an increase from an earlier 2,000 daily arrest target. Enforcement sweeps this year spurred anti-ICE demonstrations in cities including Chicago, Minneapolis and Los Angeles. In Minneapolis, two US protesters, Renee Good and Alex Pretti, were fatally shot by immigration agents
https://www.myjoyonline.com/white-house-.title_zh: 白宫誓言在中期选举失利后继续加强移民执法
https://www.myjoyonline.com/white-house-.body_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的政府上周中期选举失利后，誓言不会改变其大规模驱逐计划。白宫在向英国广播公司（BBC）发表的声明中表示：“本届政府不会放缓逮捕和驱逐那些恐吓我们社区的犯罪非法移民的努力。”特朗普周五提拔移民强硬派人士斯蒂芬·米勒出任白宫幕僚长，这表明该政府在边境安全政策上不会退缩。各州出口民调显示，移民问题是中期选举选民最看重的第三大问题，仅次于经济和民主状况。在得克萨斯州等历来保守的州，拉丁裔选民转向民主党，帮助该党锁定国会的压倒性多数席位。然而，多名美国官员向英国广播公司的美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）表示，政府将中期选举失利归咎于人们对经济、生活成本以及与伊朗战争的担忧，而非其收紧移民政策。白宫周日照例表示不会改变方向。白宫发言人劳伦·比斯说：“在移民执法方面，从来没有哪位总统比特朗普总统更坚定。”国土安全部（DHS）也表示将继续推进工作。一名国土安全部发言人对哥伦比亚广播公司说：“移民与海关执法局（ICE）绝不会后退或放慢行动。”周二投票结果公布后，副总统JD·万斯似乎愿意调整移民战略。万斯在一篇反思选举结果的长篇网络帖子中写道：“我愿意考虑我们是否应调整执法重点，例如更多地关注雇用非法劳工的企业。”但特朗普周五提拔斯蒂芬·米勒出任幕僚长后，白宫的立场似乎变得更加强硬。widely被视为特朗普第一和第二任总统任内强硬移民政策策划者的米勒，也是这一政策的设计者。移民与海关执法局（ICE）消息人士对哥伦比亚广播公司表示，近几周官员接到指示，每天目标是逮捕约2,700名非法移民，高于此前每日逮捕2,000人的目标。今年开展的执法突袭行动在芝加哥、明尼阿波利斯和洛杉矶等城市引发了反对移民与海关执法局的示威。在明尼阿波利斯，两名美国示威者蕾妮·古德和亚历克斯·普雷蒂被移民执法人员开枪致命打死

https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.summary: US tech giant Nvidia has opened an independent investigation following reports that its CEO, Jensen Huang, had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.summary_zh: 美国科技巨头英伟达启动独立调查。此前有报道称，该公司首席执行官黄仁勋与一名疑似中国间谍有交往。《纽约时报》报道，美国情报官员认为，与黄仁勋关系密切的中国女商人黄艾丽丝是北京派来的间谍。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.body: US tech giant Nvidia has opened an independent investigation following reports that its CEO, Jensen Huang, had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. The company, one of the world's most valuable, said its board had no reason to believe its secrets or national security were compromised, adding that the CEO was committed to continuing to lead the company. Separately, Jensen Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report. Jensen Huang said he took "full responsibility" for what he did, adding that he had fallen short of his responsibilities to Nvidia's employees, board and shareholders. Nvidia is one of the world's largest companies and is seen as central to making the hardware for emerging AI technologies. Its CEO said: "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry." His statement continued: "Regarding the national security concerns raised in news reports, Nvidia's Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. "I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America's national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American." A separate statement issued by Nvidia's board of directors said it would begin an investigation in "light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort". It continued: "The Board prioritises US national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of Nvidia and its shareholders. Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, is linked to Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Nvidia is a central player in AI infrastructure, providing chips to leading AI model developers including OpenAI and Meta. The microchip manufacturer is worth some $4.5 trillion, making it one of the most valuable companies ever. China previously rejected allegations of an espionage operation targeting Nvidia's chief, calling the claims "groundless speculation" . US intelligence agencies monitored Alice Huang and concluded she was acting on behalf of the Chinese government, according to unnamed sources cited by The New York Times. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang through a process known as "unmasking". It remains unclear what information Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly passed to Beijing, how valuable it was, or when she is believed to have begun gathering intelligence. Alice Huang did not respond to the paper's request for comment. Last week, members of Congress wrote to Jensen Huang, asking him to appear before them in the light of the reported relationship. Three House Republican committee leaders asked the CEO to appear later in the month, to talk about Nvidia's "security protocols against foreign adversary espionage" given his reported relation Alice Huang. "Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the PRC's [China's] access to sensitive US technology and information. "The issue of PRC infiltration and access to cutting-edge US technology is core to the investigative work of our three committees this Congress," the letter said. Nvidia's AI chips have been a major focus of the rivalry between the US and China, and Washington has previously imposed controls on where its advanced products can be sold. The H200, Nvidia's second most advanced semiconductor, had previously been restricted by Washington over concerns that it would give China's technology industry an edge over the US. In January, the Trump administration said it would allow the company to sell its H200 chips to Chinese customers under certain conditions
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.title_zh: Nvidia就首席执行官涉嫌与疑似中国间谍有染展开调查
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.body_zh:
美国科技巨头英伟达启动了一项独立调查。此前有报道称，该公司的首席执行官黄仁勋与一名疑似中国间谍存在关系。英伟达是全球市值最高的企业之一。公司表示，董事会没有理由相信公司的机密或国家安全受到损害，并补充称，首席执行官致力于继续领导公司。

与此同时，黄仁勋承认自己曾对妻子“不忠”，并为伤害妻子和孩子道歉。据《纽约时报》报道，美国情报官员认为，与黄仁勋关系密切的中国女商人黄爱丽是为北京效力的间谍。黄仁勋表示，他对自己所做的事承担“全部责任”，并称自己没有尽到对英伟达员工、董事会和股东的责任。他说：“我背叛了妻子。我所做的事伤害了妻子和孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”

他的声明接着说：“关于新闻报道提出的国家安全问题，英伟达董事会已启动独立调查。我支持这项调查，并将全力配合。

“我热爱我们的国家和公司。我致力于保护英伟达，并支持美国的国家安全。我很自豪，也很感激自己是一名美国人。”

英伟达董事会另行发表声明称，鉴于近期有报道称创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋成为外国情报行动的目标，董事会将展开调查。声明称：“董事会将美国国家和经济安全置于首位，这是压倒英伟达及其股东利益的大事。黄爱丽与黄仁勋没有亲属关系，她与总部位于新加坡的数据中心企业Megaspeed有关联。该公司上月告诉《纽约时报》，现任管理层认真对待相关指控，并已聘请外部法律顾问开展内部调查。

英伟达是人工智能基础设施领域的核心企业，向包括OpenAI和Meta在内的领先人工智能模型开发商提供芯片。这家微芯片制造商市值约4.5万亿美元，成为有史以来市值最高的公司之一。中国此前驳斥了针对英伟达首席执行官的间谍行动指控，称这些说法是“毫无根据的猜测”。

《纽约时报》援引未具名消息人士称，美国情报机构监视黄爱丽后得出结论，认为她代表中国政府行事。据报道，监视记录显示黄爱丽与一名美国公民有过通信，这名公民随后通过名为“身份揭露”的程序被确认为黄仁勋。目前尚不清楚黄爱丽——也被称为黄乐——据称向北京传递了什么信息、这些信息有多大价值，以及人们认为她从何时开始收集情报。黄爱丽没有回应该报置评请求。

上周，国会议员致函黄仁勋，要求他就这段被曝光的关系出席作证。众议院三个共和党的委员会领导人要求这位首席执行官于本月晚些时候出席，讨论英伟达“防范外国对手间谍活动的安全规程”，理由是他与黄爱丽之间被曝存在关系。信中写道：“近期报道引发了对中国获取美国敏感技术和信息这一重大国家安全问题的关注。中国渗透并获取美国尖端技术，是我们本届国会三个委员会调查工作的核心。”

英伟达的人工智能芯片一直是中美竞争的一个主要焦点，华盛顿此前也对该公司先进产品的销售地区实施限制。英伟达最先进的半导体产品H200此前受到华盛顿限制，原因是外界担心它会令中国科技产业获得相对于美国的优势。今年1月，特朗普政府表示，将在满足特定条件的情况下允许该公司向中国客户出售H200芯片

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/angl.title: Anglican Church warns Tinubu, INEC against 2027 election manipulation

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/angl.body: NNEWI — The Church of Nigeria (Anglican Communion), Province of the Niger, has warned the Presidency, the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) and the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) against manipulating the 2027 general elections or taking Nigerians for granted. The church also cautioned against moves towards a one-party system, describing the alleged intimidation of opposition parties and their candidates as dangerous to the country’s democracy. It urged Nigerians not to approach the 2027 presidential and other elections with indifference but to use their votes to hold political leaders accountable for unfulfilled promises. The Coordinating Bishop of the Province of the Niger, Bishop of Aguata and Supervising Bishop of the Diocese of Awka, Rt. Rev. Dr Samuel C. Ezeofor, gave the warning during the 2026 Anglican Prayer Rally of Anambra State (APRAS). Ezeofor recalled that the province had, during its synod in May, warned Nigerians about the dangers of a one-party system and urged citizens to remain vigilant. Addressing the Presidency, INEC, the APC and other political stakeholders, the bishop said Nigerians were increasingly dissatisfied with developments in the country and should not be taken for granted. “If they take Nigerians for granted, it may come to a point where there may be a revolution. I don’t pray for that, but by my training, I am trained to believe the best but be prepared for the worst,” he said. He urged those involved in the 2027 electoral process to respect the wishes of voters and ensure that the outcome reflected their choices. “So both the Presidency, APC, INEC and all the people who are involved in the election that is coming in 2027, let everyone of them be careful and do what Nigerians said with their ballots and would want to be done with their votes,” he added. On the internal challenges facing the Province of the Niger, Ezeofor acknowledged that some Anglican faithful might have become discouraged by the crisis within the church. He, however, urged them to remain steadfast, saying that setbacks in the church’s human administration did not mean God had abandoned it. “My message to our faithfuls is that as human beings, we may stumble, but God is still on his throne. This church belongs to God, yet it is human beings who run the church and it is also a human system,” he said. He encouraged members to continue looking up to Jesus Christ, whom he described as the author and finisher of their faith, expressing optimism that the situation would improve. The 2026 prayer rally, themed “Dwelling in the Secret Place of the Most High God”, was attended by six bishops of the province, including the retired Archbishop of the Province of the Niger, Most Rev. Prof. Godwin Okpara. Others in attendance were Bishop Ephraim Ikeako of the Diocese of Amichi, Bishop Prosper Amah of the Diocese of Ogbaru, Bishop Ndubuisi Obi of the Diocese of Nnewi and Bishop Obiora Uzochukwu of the Diocese of Niger East. Earlier, the preacher at the rally, Venerable Dr Emma Ezeugo, urged Christians to devote more time to prayer and fasting, particularly as December approaches. He said prayer brought peace, protection and peace of mind, urging believers to seek God’s presence in their daily lives. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/angl.body_zh: 恩内韦——尼日利亚教会（圣公会共融体）尼日尔教省已警告总统府、独立国家选举委员会（INEC）和执政的进步大Congress（APC），不得操纵2027年大选，也不得把尼日利亚人当作理所当然。该教会还警告不要推动一党制，并称据称对反对党及其候选人的恐吓行为危害国家民主。教会敦促尼日利亚人不应对2027年总统选举及其他选举持冷漠态度，而应利用选票追究政治领导人未兑现承诺的责任。尼日尔教省协调主教、阿古阿塔主教兼阿瓦卡教区监督主教塞缪尔·C·埃泽福尔博士阁下，在2026年阿南布拉州圣公会祈祷集会（APRAS）期间发出这一警告。埃泽福尔回顾称，该教省曾在5月举行的教区会议上警告尼日利亚人注意一党制的危险，并敦促公民保持警惕。主教向总统府、INEC、APC及其他政治利益相关者发表讲话时表示，尼日利亚人对国家 developments 越来越不满，不应被当作理所当然。他说：“如果他们把尼日利亚人当作理所当然，可能最终会爆发革命。我不祈祷这种事发生，但凭我的训练，我被教导要相信最好的结果，同时也要为最坏的情况做好准备。”他敦促参与2027年选举进程的人士尊重选民的意愿，确保选举结果反映选民的选择。他补充道：“所以，无论是总统府、APC、INEC，还是所有参与2027年即将举行的选举的人，每个人都要谨慎行事，遵照尼日利亚人用选票表达的要求，以及他们希望用选票实现的事情。”谈及尼日尔教省内部面临的问题，埃泽福尔承认，一些圣公会信徒可能因教会内部危机而感到气馁，但他敦促他们坚定不移，表示教会在人事管理方面遭遇挫折并不意味着上帝已经抛弃了教会。他说：“我给信徒的信息是，作为人类，我们可能会跌倒，但上帝仍然坐在祂的宝座上。这教会属于上帝，但由人来管理，也是一套由人运作的制度。”他鼓励会众继续仰望耶稣基督，并称耶稣基督是他们信仰的创始者和成全者，同时对局势改善表示乐观。2026年祈祷集会的主题是“住在至高上帝的隐秘处”，教省的六位主教出席了活动，其中包括尼日尔教省退休大主教戈德温·奥克帕教授阁下。出席者还包括阿米奇教区以弗莱姆·伊克亚科主教、奥格巴鲁教区普罗斯佩尔·阿马主教、恩韦伊教区恩杜比西·奥比主教，以及尼日尔东教区奥比奥拉·乌佐丘库主教。此前，集会讲道者艾玛·埃祖戈博士尊者敦促基督徒投入更多时间祈祷和禁食，尤其是随着12月临近。他说，祈祷能带来平安、保护和内心平静，并敦促信徒在日常生活中寻求上帝的临在。此处发表的评论不代表《Vanguard》报或该公司任何员工的观点

https://leadership.ng/adc-will-be-on-bal.body: The Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development, Festus Keyamo, has said the African Democratic Congress (ADC) will participate in the 2027 general elections, but warned that candidates produced by the David Mark-led faction, including former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar, may not appear on the ballot. Keyamo said the fate of the candidates would depend on the final determination of the party’s leadership dispute by the Supreme Court. The minister stated this in a post on his verified X handle on Sunday, following concerns that a recent Federal High Court judgment against the Mark-led leadership could prevent the opposition party from fielding candidates in the elections. The Federal High Court in Abuja had on Thursday nullified the Mark-led National Working Committee and invalidated decisions taken by the faction, including the presidential primary that produced Atiku as the ADC’s candidate for the 2027 election. The judgment followed a suit filed by former ADC Deputy National Chairman (North-East), Nafiu Gombe, in which he challenged the process through which Mark and other members of the caretaker committee assumed control of the party. Gombe argued that following the resignation of former National Chairman, Ralph Nwosu, he was constitutionally entitled to take over the party’s leadership. Reacting to the ruling, Keyamo dismissed suggestions that it meant the ADC would be excluded from the 2027 elections. “For the education of the public, those raising false alarm that the court judgment on ADC means the party will not be on the ballot are spreading misinformation. “The ADC will be on the ballot. It is the David Mark faction of candidates, including Atiku Abubakar, that may not be on the ballot, depending on the final judgment of the Supreme Court,” he said. The minister also questioned why the judgment was being portrayed as an attempt to prevent the opposition party from participating in the elections. He argued that candidates who emerged through the party’s original leadership structure should not be denied their political rights because of the dispute. “Therefore, the question we must ask those raising hell is: are those Nigerians who successfully won their primaries under the faction of the original owners of the ADC lesser humans or lesser Nigerians than David Mark and Atiku Abubakar?” he asked. Meanwhile, the Mark-led faction has rejected the judgment and vowed to challenge it in court. Atiku and the party have also indicated plans to appeal the ruling. The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has said it would not take a position on the dispute until it obtains and studies the certified true copy of the judgment. https://leadership.ng/zamfara-moves-to-r.body: The Zamfara State Government has taken a decisive step to reclaim its gold fields from illegal miners and criminal elements with the inauguration of a 13-man Anti-Illegal Mining Committee. The committee was inaugurated on Friday in Gusau, the state capital, by the Secretary to the State Government (SSG), Malam Abubakar Mohammad Nakwada. The move is part of the state government’s renewed effort to support the Federal Government in formalising the mining sector, restoring order in mining communities, and cutting off the funding source for banditry and terrorism in the state. The committee is headed by the State Commissioner for Environment, Hon. Abdulrahman Tumbido. It draws membership from security agencies, traditional institutions, and relevant federal and state government agencies — a structure the government says will ensure coordination, intelligence sharing and effective enforcement across all mining areas. Inaugurating the committee, Nakwada charged members to work closely with security agencies, regulatory bodies and local authorities to identify locations where illegal mining is taking place and profile the operators. He said the committee must also ensure that even licensed companies comply with relevant laws and regulations, take adequate measures to prevent environmental degradation, and safeguard the safety and rights of host communities. “The initiative is part of the state government’s efforts to assist the Federal Government in formalising the mining sector in the state,” Nakwada said. In his remarks, the Chairman of the Committee, Hon. Tumbido, assured that the committee would work with reliable information, respect for the law, fairness and regard for the rights and livelihoods of the people. He added that the committee would ensure its efforts contribute to lasting security, environmental protection and sustainable development in the state. The inauguration comes against the background of worsening insecurity in mining communities in Anka Local Government Area. On October 15, elderly residents of Birnin Doki in Anka LGA were reportedly ordered out of their homes by terror leader Muhammad Gwaska for allegedly refusing forced labour in the gold mines controlled by his gang. Displaced residents said they were forced to walk about 15 kilometres to an abandoned clinic, with no food, water or immediate state aid. Residents in the area have also alleged that terror groups now control some gold fields, decide who mines, who farms and who lives there, and tax farmers and miners to fund further attacks. The state government says the new committee is part of its response to dismantle that criminal economy, restore state authority in mining areas, and protect vulnerable communities like Birnin Doki from exploitation. Zamfara is one of Nigeria’s richest gold belts, but years of illegal mining have fuelled insecurity, environmental degradation and exploitation of host communities. With the inauguration of the committee, the state government says it is moving from rhetoric to action — to ensure that Zamfara’s mineral wealth works for its people, not for criminals. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 照片显示，美国海军和海军陆战队高级官员于周日前往韩国造船巨头HD现代重工的造船厂，评估其海军舰艇建造能力。照片拍摄的是官员们参观位于韩国东南部城市蔚山的造船厂；此时，首尔和华盛顿正依据MASGA，即“让美国造船业再次伟大”计划，联手推动美国造船业复兴。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Senior U.S. Navy and Marine Corps officials have visited Korean shipbuilding giant HD Hyundai Heavy Industries' shipyard to assess its naval shipbuilding capabilities, photos showed Sunday. Their Nov. 4 visit to the shipyard in the southeastern Korean city of Ulsan came as Seoul and Washington are jointly seeking to revive the U.S. shipbuilding industry under the MASGA, or "Make American Shipbuilding Great Again," initiative. "The visit brought together senior U.S. Navy and Marine Corps leaders to assess naval shipbuilding capabilities, installation infrastructure and logistics support across South Korea," read a photo caption of one of the uploaded photos on the Pentagon's Defense Visual Information Distribution Service (DVIDS). The delegation included Brendan P. Rogers, assistant secretary of the U.S. Navy for energy, installations and environment; U.S. Marine Corps Lt. Gen. Andrew M. Niebel, deputy commandant for installations and logistics; and U.S. Marine Corps Maj. Gen. Valerie A. Jackson, commander of U.S. Marine Corps Forces Korea. As part of the itinerary, the delegation also assessed opportunities to strengthen maritime sustainment, enhance operational readiness and reinforce the Korea-U.S. alliance, according to DVIDS. In October, HD Hyundai signed an agreement with U.S. engineering and construction company Kiewit to establish a joint venture to build a new shipyard in the United States, with plans to begin construction next year and full-scale operations in 2029

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 执政党一名官员周日在政府表示，政府已同意考虑拨款约2万亿韩元（15亿美元），用于消防工作相关的必要投资。朴表示，用于筹备消防设备和训练设施的额外预算资金，以及加强以消防工作为核心的医疗体系，也将纳入明年预算审查的考量。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The government has agreed to consider funding about 2 trillion won ($1.5 billion) for essential investments related to firefighting efforts, a ruling party official said Sunday. The move came as part of discussions to ease the fiscal burden on provincial governments, Democratic Party of Korea chief spokesperson Park Sung-joon said at a press briefing following a consultation session between the government, the ruling party and Cheong Wa Dae. Additional budget funds to prepare firefighting equipment and training facilities, as well as strengthening a medical system centered on firefighting efforts, will also be factored in for a review of next year's budget, Park said. Currently, provincial governments fund the bulk of the firefighting-related budget, with only about 10 percent of the total amount funded by the central government. At the meeting, Prime Minister Han Seong-sook said the government will review whether it is providing full support for firefighters before asking them to devote themselves to public safety. In the meeting, held a day ahead of the 64th anniversary of the Day of Firefighting, Han paid tribute to the late Kim Jin-seok, a firefighter who died while responding to a factory fire in Bucheon, west of Seoul, last month. "There are many things for the government to take care of, but the lives and safety of the public are one of the top priorities. There is nothing that precedes this," Han said. Han, meanwhile, vowed to thoroughly inspect preparations for the winter cold, stressing that heavy snow and cold are natural disasters that threaten people's daily lives
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 政府将审查为消防工作提供的15亿美元资金支持

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: Korea is facing growing concerns that a sharp stock market decline triggered by fears of U.S. restrictions on artificial intelligence (AI) data center construction could spill over into the real economy, as such curbs, if implemented, could threaten semiconductor exports and weigh on next year’s growth, analysts said Sunday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 分析师周日表示，韩国正面临越来越多的担忧：因市场担忧美国将限制人工智能数据中心建设而引发的股市大幅下跌，可能外溢至实体经济；如果实施此类限制，可能威胁韩国半导体出口，并拖累明年的增长。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Korea is facing growing concerns that a sharp stock market decline triggered by fears of U.S. restrictions on artificial intelligence (AI) data center construction could spill over into the real economy, as such curbs, if implemented, could threaten semiconductor exports and weigh on next year’s growth, analysts said Sunday. The Democrats’ victory in the U.S. midterm elections last week has fueled speculation that the party could push for tighter oversight of data center projects, although specific measures have yet to be announced. Korea’s economy has benefited substantially from the global AI boom this year, with strong semiconductor exports providing a major boost to growth. Semiconductors accounted for 49 percent of the country’s total exports in October, and the Bank of Korea (BOK) estimates that the industry will contribute roughly half of the country's economic growth this year. These concerns have already taken a toll on Korean stocks. Both the benchmark KOSPI and secondary bourse Kosdaq lost 10.43 percent and 8.54 percent, respectively, over the three trading sessions following the U.S. midterm elections, from Wednesday to Friday. Samsung Electronics fell 14.03 percent, while SK hynix tumbled 19.03 percent. A prolonged stock market slump could erode household wealth and further weaken private consumption, which declined in the third quarter despite stronger-than-expected economic growth. The economy grew 1 percent from the previous quarter, well above the central bank's forecast of 0.3 percent, its advance estimate showed. While semiconductor exports and equipment investment supported growth, household spending declined 0.2 percent, with purchases of both goods and services falling. He added that the extent of the economic impact would depend largely on the scope and severity of any restrictions. “Close attention should be paid to whether policymakers and lawmakers seek to halt data center construction altogether or instead allow projects to proceed under stricter requirements,” he said. Potential changes to U.S. data center policy have added uncertainty to Korea’s growth outlook for 2027. The BOK projected Korea's economy to grow by 2.9 percent next year in its August forecast. The state-run Korea Development Institute and the Ministry of Finance and Economy both forecast 2.2 percent, in August and July respectively. The International Monetary Fund projected 2.8 percent growth in October, and the OECD forecast 2.6 percent in September. The outlook could change depending on the scope of any U.S. restrictions and their impact on AI infrastructure investments. Later this month, the central bank is set to release updated economic projections, which the government is expected to reflect in its economic policy plan for next year. The developments in the U.S. are being closely watched by Samsung Electronics and SK hynix, both of which are expanding their manufacturing operations there. Texas, where Samsung Electronics is building a new foundry, has drawn particular attention following the midterm elections. Democrats Gina Hinojosa and James Talarico won the state's gubernatorial and Senate races, respectively. Hinojosa has called for conditions on taxes, electricity rates, water use and construction labor for newly approved data center projects, though she noted that projects that have already received approval can proceed. Long-term supply agreements between chipmakers and major customers could help cushion any near-term fluctuations in demand. However, much will depend on how U.S. policy takes shape and whether new restrictions affect projects already in the pipeline
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 封面故事：韩国由芯片驱动的增长面临美国可能限制数据中心的风险
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国正面临越来越多的担忧：因市场担忧美国可能限制人工智能（AI）数据中心建设而引发的股市大跌，可能外溢至实体经济。分析人士周日表示，此类限制一旦实施，可能威胁韩国半导体出口，并拖累明年的增长。上周美国中期选举中，民主党获胜，这加剧了外界猜测：该党可能推动对数据中心项目实施更严格的监管，尽管目前尚未公布具体措施。今年全球人工智能热潮显著带动韩国经济，强劲的半导体出口为增长提供了主要支撑。10月，半导体占该国出口总额的49%；韩国银行（BOK）估计，该行业今年将贡献该国约一半的经济增长。这些担忧已经对韩国股市造成打击。在美国中期选举后的三个交易日，即周三至周五期间，主要指数KOSPI和二级市场KOSDAQ分别下跌10.43%和8.54%。Samsung Electronics下跌14.03%，SK hynix重挫19.03%。股市长期低迷可能侵蚀家庭财富，并进一步削弱私人消费；第三季度私人消费下降，尽管经济增长强于预期。央行预估数据显示，经济环比增长1%，远高于央行此前预测的0.3%。半导体出口和设备投资支撑了增长，但家庭支出下降0.2%，商品和服务购买量均出现下滑。他补充称，经济受影响程度将在很大程度上取决于任何限制措施的范围和严厉程度。他说：“应密切关注政策制定者和议员究竟是寻求彻底叫停数据中心建设，还是允许项目在更严格的要求下继续推进。”美国数据中心政策可能发生的变化，为韩国2027年的增长前景增添了不确定性。韩国银行在8月的预测中预计韩国经济明年增长2.9%。国有机构韩国开发研究院和财政经济部分别在8月和7月预测增长2.2%。国际货币基金组织10月预测增长2.8%，经济合作与发展组织9月预测增长2.6%。前景可能因美国限制措施的范围及其对人工智能基础设施投资的影响而发生变化。本月晚些时候，央行将发布 updated 经济预测，预计政府将在明年的经济政策计划中反映这些预测。Samsung Electronics和SK hynix正密切关注美国的发展局势，两家公司都在扩大其在该国的制造业务。中期选举后，Samsung Electronics正在那里新建晶圆厂的得克萨斯州引起了特别关注。民主党人Gina Hinojosa和James Talarico分别赢得该州州长和联邦参议员选举。Hinojosa主张对新建数据中心项目的税收、电价、用水和建筑用工设置附加条件，但她指出，已经获得批准的项目可以继续推进。芯片制造商与主要客户之间的长期供应协议，有助于缓冲近期需求波动。然而，最终结果将很大程度上取决于美国政策的形成方式，以及新限制措施是否影响已经进入实施阶段的项目

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: E-commerce giant feels pressure to broaden political ties as Republican allies lose control of key committees Coupang is facing growing pressure to broaden its lobbying strategy in the United States beyond its Republican allies following the Democrats' sweeping midterm election victory, experts and industry officials said Sunday. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 共和党盟友失去关键委员会控制权后，电商巨头面临扩大政治关系的压力 周日，专家和业内人士表示，在民主党于中期选举中取得全面胜利后，Coupang在美国扩大游说策略、拓展共和党盟友以外政治关系的压力日益增加。业内人士表示，Coupang可能会加大在美国的游说力度，以抵御韩国监管压力。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: E-commerce giant feels pressure to broaden political ties as Republican allies lose control of key committees Coupang is facing growing pressure to broaden its lobbying strategy in the United States beyond its Republican allies following the Democrats' sweeping midterm election victory, experts and industry officials said Sunday. The change could be particularly impactful for the e-commerce giant, whose lobbying efforts have helped draw attention in Washington to its dispute with Korean regulators. Republican lawmakers, including members of the House Judiciary Committee, have publicly criticized what they described as discriminatory treatment of the U.S.-headquartered firm in Korea. With Democrats now set to control both chambers of Congress, the institutional backing Coupang has received from Republican lawmakers is expected to weaken, prompting experts and industry watchers to say the company will have to broaden its relationships across both parties to maintain its influence in Washington. “Especially for a digital-focused firm like Coupang, which remains subject to policies under the Republican administration, it is important to balance lobbying efforts between Democrats and Republicans,” said Shin Won-kyu, head of the global economic research team at the Federation of Korean Industries. Coupang's political spending already shows signs of such a shift. According to political contribution records filed with the Federal Election Commission, COUPAC, a political action committee established by Coupang to support U.S. congressional candidates, contributed $185,000 (252 million won) to members of Congress and affiliated political organizations during the first three quarters of this year, up 18.2 percent from a year earlier. Of this year's contributions, $107,000 went to Democratic lawmakers, Democratic-affiliated election organizations and political action committees, while $78,000 went to Republicans and their affiliated groups. Coupang's contributions to Democrats jumped 52.9 percent from a year earlier, while those to Republicans fell 9.8 percent. The figures indicate that the company had already stepped up its overall political spending ahead of the midterms, anticipating a Democratic victory. The shift suggests Coupang had begun preparing for a possible change in the balance of power. "Coupang should pursue lobbying on roughly a 50-50 basis to maintain a balance in the U.S.," said Kim Dae-jong, a professor of business administration at Sejong University. “U.S. President Donald Trump is still a Republican, while Democrats now control both chambers of Congress.” The need for a bipartisan strategy is closely tied to the nature of Coupang's regulatory dispute in Korea. The company has faced scrutiny from Korean authorities over its handling of a massive data breach and other alleged business malpractices, and some U.S. lawmakers have raised concerns about whether Korean regulators are treating U.S. companies fairly. In July, Republican Rep. Michael Baumgartner, a vocal supporter of Coupang in Congress, introduced a bill that would bar foreign government officials from entering the U.S. if they engage in economic discrimination against U.S. companies. He won reelection in Washington state, but will return to a House controlled by Democrats — underscoring the need for Coupang to expand its lobbying reach beyond Republican allies. Industry officials said Coupang could step up its lobbying efforts in the U.S. as it seeks to defend itself against regulatory pressure in Korea. “Korean regulatory authorities show no signs of backing down from their hard-line stance against Coupang’s data breach or other unfair business activities, so the company will rely more on U.S. lobbying to raise its voice against Korean authorities,” an industry official said. A Coupang spokesperson declined to comment on the details of its U.S. lobbying strategy
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 中期选举后，Coupang面临扩大美国游说战略的压力
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 共和党盟友失去关键委员会控制权，电商巨头面临扩大政治关系的压力 专家和行业官员周日报道称，在民主党于中期选举中取得全面胜利后，电商巨头Coupang面临越来越大的压力，需要将其在美国的游说策略从共和党盟友扩大到其他阵营。这一变化对这家电商巨头的影响可能尤其显著，因为其游说努力曾帮助提请华盛顿关注该公司与韩国监管机构的争端。包括众议院司法委员会成员在内的共和党议员，曾公开批评他们所称的美国总部设在韩国的企业遭受歧视性待遇。随着民主党即将控制国会两院，Republican议员给予Coupang的机构支持预计将减弱，促使专家和行业观察人士表示，该公司必须扩大与两党的关系，才能维持在华盛顿的影响力。 韩国商工联会全球经济研究团队负责人Shin Won-kyu表示：“尤其是对于Coupang这样一家以数字业务为主的公司而言，其业务仍受共和党政府政策约束，因此在民主党和共和党之间平衡游说努力十分重要。” Coupang的政治支出已经显现出这种转变的迹象。根据提交给联邦选举委员会的政治献金记录，Coupang为支持美国国会候选人而成立的政治行动委员会COUPAC，今年前三个季度向国会议员及其关联政治组织捐出185,000美元（2.52亿韩元），较上年同期增长18.2%。今年捐款中，107,000美元流向民主党议员、民主党关联选举组织和政治行动委员会，78,000美元则流向共和党及其关联团体。Coupang对民主党的捐款较上年同期跃升52.9%，对共和党的捐款则下降9.8%。这些数字显示，公司在中期选举前已加大整体政治支出，预判民主党将取得胜利。这一转变表明，Coupang已经开始为权力格局可能发生的变化做准备。 世宗大学工商管理学教授Kim Dae-jong表示：“Coupang应当以大约五五开的比例开展游说，以维持在美国内部的平衡。”“美国总统唐纳德·特朗普仍是共和党人，而民主党现在控制着国会两院。” 采取两党战略的需要与Coupang在韩国所面临监管争端的性质密切相关。该公司因处理大规模数据泄露及其他涉嫌不当商业行为而受到韩国当局审查，一些美国议员则担忧韩国监管机构是否公平对待美国企业。7月，共和党众议员Michael Baumgartner在国会上大力支持Coupang，并提出一项法案，禁止对实施经济歧视的美国企业的外国政府官员进入美国。他在华盛顿州成功连任，但将回到由民主党控制的众议院，这进一步凸显了Coupang需要将游说触角扩大到共和党盟友之外。 行业官员表示，Coupang正在寻求抵御韩国的监管压力，因此可能加大在美国的游说力度。一名行业官员说：“韩国监管机构没有迹象表明会放弃针对Coupang数据泄露及其他不公平商业活动的强硬立场，因此该公司将更多依靠美国游说活动来反对韩国当局。” Coupang发言人拒绝对其美国游说策略的细节置评

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 一名韩国议员周日表示，美国承认某些与政策有关的变量可能影响战时作战指挥权移交首尔，但再次强调将遵守现有双边协议，根据商定条件推进移交。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The United States acknowledged that certain policy-related variables could affect the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) to Seoul, but reaffirmed its commitment to the existing bilateral agreement that the handover will proceed based on agreed conditions, a Korean lawmaker said Sunday. Rep. Jin Sung-joon of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK), who chairs the National Assembly’s National Defense Committee, briefed reporters at the National Assembly on the outcome of a parliamentary delegation’s trip to the United States from Nov. 1 to 5. He said the delegation was granted entry approval only at the last minute, but was still able to proceed with its scheduled visit to U.S. Indo-Pacific Command and its subordinate component commands in Hawaii. Asked whether the Democratic sweep in the U.S. midterm elections could affect the OPCON transfer process, Jin said he did not expect any significant changes. "Korea and the U.S. have discussed and reached agreements over OPCON transfer for more than 20 years. A Democratic victory (in the U.S.) would not affect the existing bilateral agreements," he said. Regarding the postponement of the Security Consultative Meeting between Korea and the U.S., originally scheduled for November, until next year, Jin cited U.S. officials saying the delay was unrelated to any differences over the OPCON transfer. "The U.S. said the decision was made after taking into account the two countries' defense ministers' and senior military officials' schedules," he added. Jin said U.S. officials assessed the security situation on the Korean Peninsula as stable, despite a series of North Korean actions in the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), including the demolition of inter-Korean connecting roads and the fortification of areas along the Military Demarcation Line (MDL). "However, the officials stressed the need to maintain military readiness, citing North Korea's growing nuclear and missile capabilities and the possibility of abrupt policy shifts," said Jin. Adm. Stephen T. Koehler, commander of the U.S. Pacific Fleet, reportedly said Korea's pursuit of nuclear-powered submarines could strengthen the alliance, expressing willingness to cooperate pending policy decisions by both governments. On Seoul’s request for cooperation in relocating Gwangju Air Base to build a mega semiconductor cluster, Gen. Kevin B. Schneider, commander of Pacific Air Forces, said the relocation is a sovereign decision for the Korean government, while the U.S. military's role is to assess and advise on potential military risks. Asked whether United States Forces of Korea Commander Gen. Xavier Brunson came up in the talks, Jin said he did, but declined to elaborate. Brunson recently drew criticism from ruling party lawmakers after he said, at a seminar in Washington on Oct. 14, that Korea begins at the southern boundary fence line of the DMZ from the perspective of the United Nations Command. The remark sparked controversy because it could be interpreted as placing Korea’s territorial boundary at the southern edge of the DMZ, 2 kilometers south of the MDL. The southern half of the DMZ, which includes villages where South Korean residents live, lies north of that line
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 国防委员会主席称，尽管美国中期选举结果如何，OPCON协议仍然有效
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 一名韩国议员周日表示，美国承认某些与政策相关的变量可能影响战时作战指挥权（OPCON）移交首尔的时间，但再次强调将遵守现有双边协议，在既定条件下推进移交。执政的韩国民主党的金成埈议员担任国会国防委员会主席，他在国会向记者介绍国会代表团于11月1日至5日访问美国的成果。他说，该代表团直到最后一刻才获准入境，但仍得以按计划访问美国印太司令部及其下属驻夏威夷各司令部。记者问，美国中期选举中民主党获胜是否可能影响OPCON移交进程，金成埈表示，他预计不会出现重大变化。他说：“韩国和美国就OPCON移交问题已经讨论并达成协议超过20年。民主党（在美国）获胜不会影响现有双边协议。”谈及原定于11月举行、后推迟至明年的韩美安全磋商会议，金成埈援引美国官员的话称，推迟与双方在OPCON移交问题上的分歧无关。他补充说：“美国表示，这一决定是在考虑两国国防部长和高级军事官员的日程后作出的。”金成埈说，尽管朝鲜在非军事区（DMZ）采取一系列行动，包括拆除南北连接道路以及在军事分界线沿线加固设施，美国官员仍评估朝鲜半岛安全局势保持稳定。金成埈说：“不过，这些官员强调必须维持战备状态，理由是朝鲜的核与导弹能力不断增强，其政策也可能突然转向。”据报道，美国太平洋舰队司令斯蒂芬·T·科勒海军上将表示，韩国发展核动力潜艇的努力能够加强同盟，并表示愿意在两国政府作出政策决定前提供合作。应首尔请求，为建设大型半导体产业集群而合作搬迁光州空军基地，太平洋空军司令凯文·B·施奈德将军表示，搬迁是韩国政府的主权决定，而美国军队的职责是评估潜在军事风险并提供建议。记者问，驻韩美军司令泽维尔·布伦森将军是否在会谈中被提及，金成埈表示确有提及，但拒绝进一步说明。布伦森最近受到执政党议员批评。他于10月14日在华盛顿的一场研讨会上表示，从联合国司令部角度看，韩国始于非军事区南侧围栏线。这番言论引发争议，因为它可能被解读为把韩国的领土边界划在非军事区南缘，即军事分界线以南2公里处。非军事区南半部包括有韩国居民居住的村庄，位于该界线以北

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary_zh: 韩国股市遭遇“黑色星期五”，亟需改革。韩国股市最近的“黑色星期五”引发熔断机制与卖方停牌机制同时启动，主要交易所指数下跌逾6%。与此同时，上周中期选举后立即上涨的美国股市指数也出现下跌。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body: 'Black Friday' for KOSPI prompts needs for reforms The recent "Black Friday" for the Korean stock market brought a frantic mixture of a circuit breaker and sell-side sidecars as the main bourse fell more than 6 percent. Benchmark KOSPI heavyweights SK hynix and Samsung Electronics also took a hit, with their shares falling 10.44 percent and 6.35 percent, respectively, as investors sold in panic, driving the index below 5,000 during trading. Meanwhile, U.S. indexes that had risen immediately after last week's midterm elections also fell. Investors and policymakers woke up to a changed economic climate, triggered by a shift in the U.S. political landscape. Any optimism that last week's U.S. midterm elections had reaffirmed the country’s democratic values was tempered by concerns over the Democrats’ agenda to regulate artificial intelligence (AI) and restrict data center construction. A deeper concern is that these policy shifts come amid growing skepticism over whether the AI boom is actually a bubble and whether massive investments in the sector will ultimately generate profits. Other Asian stock markets, including Taiwan's, also declined Friday. But Seoul’s heavy reliance on its semiconductor sector amplified market volatility, which was pushed up even higher by President Lee Jae Myung's strong pledge to tackle the so-called "Korea discount." In response to the sharp decline, senior officials from Korea’s economic, financial regulatory and monetary agencies convened to discuss emergency measures, including a three-month exemption from collateral reserve requirements on loans to investors in an effort to curb further selling. The measure may for the time being bring some peace to investors, but they now depressed and distrustful are also likely to be wary of government measures. Aggressive investments in AI and a sustained drive in the U.S. to build data centers also contributed to the strong performance by Korea's top chipmakers. But the market landscape has shifted, as has the balance of power in the U.S. Congress. The episode should prompt Korea and its financial authorities to pursue more fundamental reforms to guard against future market shocks. Structural reforms take time, but with the Korean economy forecast to grow by around 3 percent this year, the country must use that momentum to diversify its economic base and reduce its vulnerability to external shocks. We have repeatedly called for greater economic diversification, particularly to reduce the concentration of semiconductors in Korea’s exports and stock market. Exports of semiconductors including high-bandwidth memory and conventional memory chips are estimated to account for about 40 percent of the country’s total exports, which are on track to reach a record $1 trillion as early as this month. SK hynix and Samsung Electronics also make up about 40 percent of KOSPI's total market capitalization. This structure cannot continue to drive sustainable growth for Korea, nor can it produce the surplus profits that fill government coffers. At the same time, Korea cannot afford to lose its competitive edge in semiconductors and must continue investing in research, development and innovation, as reflected in the government’s plans for three major semiconductor projects. The surplus profits from the current chip boom gave the government the confidence to pursue its "three megaprojects," but it still needs future growth engines. Policymakers should focus on deregulation to revive the automotive, shipping and battery sectors, while fostering an environment for emerging sectors such as robotics, biotechnology and small modular reactors to become new engines of growth
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.title_zh: 美国中期选举结果影响韩国股市指数
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body_zh: 韩国股市经历“黑色星期五”，凸显改革需求。韩国股市近期经历“黑色星期五”，主要交易所综合指数跌幅超过6%，熔断机制与卖方临时停牌机制同时启动，市场陷入恐慌。基准指数KOSPI的权重股SK hynix和Samsung Electronics也遭重创，股价分别下跌10.44%和6.35%。投资者恐慌抛售，指数在交易期间跌破5,000点。与此同时，上周美国中期选举结束后一度上涨的美国各大股指也出现下跌。投资者和政策制定者醒来后面对的是一种已经改变的经济环境，其诱因是美国政治格局的转变。上周美国中期选举重新确认该国民主价值观，本应令人们感到乐观，但民主党监管人工智能（AI）和限制数据中心建设的议程引发了担忧。更深层的忧虑在于，人们日益怀疑人工智能热潮是否真是一股泡沫，以及对该行业的大规模投资最终能否创造利润。包括台湾在内的其他亚洲股市周五也出现下跌。然而，首尔过度依赖半导体行业，加剧了市场波动；李在明总统大力承诺解决所谓的“韩国折价”，进一步推高了波动。为应对这一急跌，韩国经济、金融监管和货币机构的高层官员召开会议，讨论应急措施，包括对投资者贷款实施3个月的抵押品准备金要求豁免，以遏制进一步抛售。这项措施或许能暂时安抚投资者，但当前情绪低落、疑虑重重的投资者也可能对政府措施保持警惕。对人工智能进行激进投资，以及美国持续推动建设数据中心，也助力韩国头部芯片制造商取得亮眼表现。然而，市场格局已经改变，美国国会中的权力平衡也是如此。这一事件应促使韩国及其金融 authorities推进更为根本的改革，以防范未来的市场冲击。结构性改革需要时间，而预计韩国经济今年将增长约3%，该国必须利用这一势头实现经济基础多元化，降低对外部冲击的脆弱性。我们反复呼吁推进更大程度的经济多元化，尤其是降低半导体在韩国出口和股市中的集中度。包括高带宽内存和传统存储芯片在内的半导体出口，据估计约占该国出口总额的40%；出口总额最早有望在本月达到创纪录的1万亿美元。SK hynix和Samsung Electronics还合计占KOSPI总市值约40%。这种结构无法继续为韩国推动可持续增长，也无法创造充盈政府财政的过剩利润。与此同时，韩国不能失去在半导体领域的竞争优势，必须继续投资研发和创新；政府计划推进的3个大型半导体项目正体现了这一点。当前芯片热潮带来的过剩利润使政府有信心推进其“三大超级项目”，但韩国仍需打造未来的增长引擎。政策制定者应重点推进放松管制，以重振汽车、航运和电池行业，同时为机器人、生物技术和小型模块化反应堆等新兴行业营造环境，使其成为新的增长引擎

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: US calls for coordinated action against N. Korean cyber threats following Binance hack
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: The United States on Saturday called for international cooperation to combat North Korea's illicit cyber activities following a massive cryptocurrency theft involving Binance. "Particularly in light of the recent hack of Binance, it is critical for governments to work together and do their own part to mitigate the DPRK cyber threat and curb illicit DPRK revenue generation," a State Department spokesperson told Yonhap News Agency in a written response.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 美国星期六呼吁加强国际合作，打击朝鲜的非法网络活动，此前发生了涉及Binance的大规模加密货币盗窃案。美国国务院发言人在书面回复中告诉韩联社：“尤其考虑到Binance近期遭黑客攻击，各国政府必须携手合作，尽到各自责任，减轻朝鲜带来的网络威胁，并切断朝鲜的非法收入来源。”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: The United States on Saturday called for international cooperation to combat North Korea's illicit cyber activities following a massive cryptocurrency theft involving Binance. "Particularly in light of the recent hack of Binance, it is critical for governments to work together and do their own part to mitigate the DPRK cyber threat and curb illicit DPRK revenue generation," a State Department spokesperson told Yonhap News Agency in a written response. DPRK stands for the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, North Korea's official name. The remarks were made in response to an inquiry about potential coordination between Washington and Seoul on additional sanctions following the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation's attribution of the cryptocurrency theft to North Korean actors. The spokesperson also emphasized the importance of enforcing existing international sanctions and taking measures to prevent Pyongyang from financing its weapons programs. "We expect all U.N. member states to enforce existing sanctions and take proactive measures to prevent the DPRK from funding its unlawful WMD and ballistic missile programs," the spokesperson said. "Coordinated unilateral sanctions continue to be a strong tool to prevent the flow of money that supports the proliferation of weapons," the spokesperson added. The remarks came after a South Korean unification ministry official said Thursday that Seoul had not yet begun discussing sanctions over the incident because the circumstances surrounding the theft had not been fully established. South Korea's foreign ministry separately said it was internally reviewing possible additional measures, including unilateral cyber sanctions, but that no decision had been made. The State Department did not directly address whether Washington had shared investigative findings with Seoul or held bilateral discussions on additional sanctions in connection with the incident
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: Binance遭黑客攻击后，美国呼吁协调应对朝鲜网络威胁
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 美国周六呼吁开展国际合作，打击朝鲜的非法网络活动。此前，Binance遭遇大规模加密货币盗窃案。美国国务院发言人在书面回复韩联社时表示：“尤其考虑到近期Binance被盗事件，各国政府必须加强合作，各尽其责，减轻朝鲜网络威胁，并切断朝鲜非法收入来源。”DPRK是朝鲜的正式名称“朝鲜民主主义人民共和国”。这番表态是在回应有关华盛顿与首尔可能协调追加制裁的问题。此前，美国联邦调查局将该起加密货币盗窃案归咎于朝鲜方面。该发言人还强调，执行现有国际制裁以及采取措施阻止平壤资助其武器计划至关重要。发言人说：“我们期望所有联合国会员国执行现有制裁，并采取主动措施，防止朝鲜为其非法的大规模杀伤性武器和弹道导弹计划提供资金。”发言人补充道：“协调一致的单边制裁仍是阻止资金流向支持武器扩散势力的有力工具。”此前，韩国统一部官员周四表示，由于围绕这起盗窃案的有关情况尚未完全查明，首尔尚未开始讨论针对此事的制裁。韩国外交部则单独表示，正在内部审查可能采取的追加措施，包括单边网络制裁，但尚未作出决定。美国国务院没有直接回应华盛顿是否与首尔共享了调查结论，或双方是否就与此案有关的追加制裁举行了双边讨论

https://leadership.ng/2027-elections-70-.summary: In a press statement on Sunday, CentreSGD said the rising violence posed a systemic threat to the electoral process, with fewer than 70 days remaining before the January 16, 2027 presidential and National Assembly elections. CentreSGD identified recent attacks in Enugu, Katsina, Ekiti, Sokoto and Kebbi, including the reported killing of an NDC supporter during a campaign flag-off in Enugu, attacks on APC convoys in Katsina, and the assault on AAC presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore in Ado-Ekiti.
https://leadership.ng/2027-elections-70-.summary_zh: CentreSGD在周日的新闻声明中表示，不断加剧的暴力行为对选举进程构成系统性威胁，距离2027年1月16日举行的总统和国民议会选举已不足70天。CentreSGD列举了恩古、卡塔西、埃基蒂、索科托和凯比等地近期发生的袭击，包括据报道在恩古的一次竞选启动集会上杀害一名全国民主大会党支持者、在卡塔西袭击全尼日利亚进步大会党车队，以及在阿多-埃基蒂袭击争取人民民主党总统候选人奥莫耶莱·索沃雷。
https://leadership.ng/2027-elections-70-.body: In a press statement on Sunday, CentreSGD said the rising violence posed a systemic threat to the electoral process, with fewer than 70 days remaining before the January 16, 2027 presidential and National Assembly elections. . Citing Yiaga Africa’s September 2026 National Voting Intentions Survey, the centre said 61 per cent of Nigerians feared violence could prevent them from voting, with the figure rising to 78 per cent in the North-East. She added that 84 per cent of respondents were likely or very likely to vote, while 83 per cent said improved security would encourage participation. CentreSGD identified recent attacks in Enugu, Katsina, Ekiti, Sokoto and Kebbi, including the reported killing of an NDC supporter during a campaign flag-off in Enugu, attacks on APC convoys in Katsina, and the assault on AAC presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore in Ado-Ekiti. The ED also cited allegations of attacks on ADC campaign convoys in Sokoto and Kebbi. The centre noted that some of the incidents were disputed by the parties and authorities concerned, stressing that it did not pronounce on culpability but demanded thorough investigations and prosecution where evidence warranted. The Centre said police arrests linked to the Katsina and Ekiti incidents should lead to transparent prosecutions. It warned that fear could undermine voter participation, particularly among young people, women and persons with disabilities, noting that only 40 per cent of young respondents were very likely to vote, compared with 64 per cent of Nigerians aged 61 and above. The organisation also expressed concern over alleged use of state-linked security outfits and administrative machinery against opposition parties, citing the Sokoto convoy allegations, the sealing of the ADC state office and reported campaign billboard permit fees of up to N200 million in Abia and N150 million in Enugu, Kogi and Cross River. CentreSGD called on the Nigeria Police Force and other security agencies to conduct prompt, transparent and non-partisan investigations into election-related attacks and prosecute perpetrators and sponsors regardless of political affiliation. It also urged political leaders and candidates to condemn violent rhetoric and enforce discipline among party supporters. The centre further called on INEC and the Inter-Agency Consultative Committee on Election Security to publish a threat-based national election security plan, while urging state governments to guarantee equal access to campaign venues, public facilities, permits and advertising spaces.
